record.description: A window perch that mounts on glass with nut suction cups, giving cats a raised resting spot with an outdoor view. It has two adjustable levels and a removable plush mattress that is machine washable. The metal frame supports up to 55 pounds.

Women's slip-on slipper from Merrell in black, with a wrap-style design for easy wear. Its outsole is designed to provide durable traction. The listing offers few other details, so check the size chart before ordering.

A long buffalo plaid table runner in black and white with a rustic farmhouse look. It measures 13 by 108 inches, which suits tables for eight to ten people. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it is machine washable and suits holidays, parties, and everyday dining.

A black Linerlock folding knife, Harley Tec X model, from Case. The package measures about 2.8 by 4.8 by 13 centimeters and weighs 0.14 kilograms. The listing classes it as sporting goods and gives China as the country of origin. Blade length is not listed.

An indoor stationary exercise bike with a 30-pound flywheel and manual resistance adjustment for customizable workouts. The padded seat moves on two axes and the aero handlebars adjust to arm length. A built-in water bottle holder and phone or accessory holder are included, making it suitable for home use.

A camouflage backpack for elementary school kids with a red camo print and a lightweight build. It has four compartments, including a laptop sleeve and a small zippered pouch, plus two mesh side pockets for water bottles. The padded S-shaped straps are adjustable, and a top handle helps carry it.

A pair of semi-sheer linen blend curtain panels in a dove shade with nickel grommet tops. Each panel measures 52 by 84 inches and fits rods up to 1 1/4 inches. They soften daylight while keeping some privacy, and they can be machine washed in cold water.

A nail polish from Sally Hansen's Xtreme Wear line in the Iris Illusion shade. The formula is designed to be strong and long-lasting, with rich color and shine. It comes in a 0.4 fluid ounce bottle, and the listing describes it as on-trend.

A black mug tree that holds cups by their handles, suited to mugs and teacups of many sizes. Its curved branches keep mugs steady, and it can store them vertically to save counter and cabinet space. A looped carrying handle makes it easy to move between a countertop and a coffee station.

A men's jacket from Carhartt's Full Swing Cryder line in a shadow color, built for rugged wear. It has a water-repellent finish and stretch technology for easier movement. The flexible elbow reduces restriction, and the back is designed for quick recovery as you swing your arms.

A foldable laundry basket with two removable dirty clothes bags, offering 74 liters of capacity. The frame is made from four fiber rods that keep it upright, and the 600D Oxford fabric is designed for durability. When folded it takes up much less space, which suits travel, dorms, and small laundry rooms.

An officially licensed Echidna prize figure from the Re:Zero anime series, made by Taito in its Coreful line. It is shown in a Mandarin dress version and includes a base stand for display. The listing gives multiple colors rather than one main color.

A women's down jacket in black with 700-fill-power goose down insulation. It has an Omni-Tech waterproof and breathable shell, Omni-Heat thermal reflective insulation, and four-way stretch for comfort. The removable storm hood fits over a helmet, and there are underarm vents and a zippered waist pocket.

Cotton socks for babies and toddlers with rubber grips on the sole to help them walk, crawl, and play on slick floors. The ankle cuff is designed to stay comfortable and not too tight, and the heel tabs make them easier to put on. Sizes run from 0 to 36 months.

An unframed canvas print of Edward Hopper's People in the Sun, reproduced in high resolution with vivid colors. It measures 50 by 80 centimeters and is printed on glossy canvas with inkjet printing. Suitable for living rooms, offices, cafes, and hotels, and each canvas is individually packaged for safe delivery.

A fitted poplin dress shirt from Van Heusen in solid grey, with a point collar that works with or without a tie. It is made to resist wrinkles for easy care, and the adjustable cuffs have two button positions. A chest pocket provides space for essentials.

A red steel wagon with all-steel construction and 10-inch rubber tires for a smooth ride. Its long pull handle folds under for storage, and the controlled turning radius helps prevent tipping. It suits toddlers and cargo such as garden supplies, and the listing gives a 150 to 200 pound capacity.

A wire-free full-coverage bra from Vanity Fair's Brilliance line in star white, sized 38C. Lightly lined cups provide support and modesty, and the silky fabric sits smoothly under clothes. The back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles, and the hook-and-eye closure offers three adjustment settings.

A set of four 24-ounce cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP plastic. They are unbreakable, lightweight, and free of BPA, and they can go in the dishwasher and microwave. Suitable for cereal, salad, noodles, and fruit, with a temperature resistance up to 120 degrees Celsius.

A dark blue cake topper with a large number one, made for a baby boy's first birthday. It is cut from cardboard with sparkly blue glitter card and arrives pre-assembled, so it can be placed on a cake. Its non-toxic materials leave no residue, and it works as a photo prop.

Maintenance-free sintered bronze sleeve bearings with a 12 mm inner diameter and 15 mm outer diameter. They have a flange and are self-lubricating. Their copper color and wear resistance suit general applications with moderate speeds and loads.

A compact wireless plotter from HP's DesignJet T100 line for large-format drawings in a home or small office. It handles sheets from 8.3 to 24 inches wide and rolls from 11 to 24 inches, with an automatic cutter. It supports Wi-Fi and mobile printing.

A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies in the 6 to 12 month size. The 4-way stretch fabric is soft and flexible, moving with the baby. Expandable shoulders make them easier to pull over the head, and reinforced snaps are designed to last.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5-quart sizes for whisking and serving. They are stackable to save space, and the metal resists stains, odors, and rust. The bowls are refrigerator, freezer, and dishwasher safe, and the listing notes a Cook's Illustrated top rating.

A short-sleeve summer A-line dress with a V neck, butterfly sleeves, and a high waist, in an all-over print on burnt orange. The fabric has no stretch and can be machine or hand washed. Check the size chart before ordering; the XL bust is 45.7 inches.

A green cactus-print lanyard for holding an ID badge and keys, made of soft polyester. It is about 19.2 inches long, and the card holder fits two ID cards. A metal key clasp is included, and the design also works as a gift for family or friends.

A short-sleeve women's graphic tee with a funny Halloween print referencing the Sanderson Sisters. It is made from a soft cotton blend that is stretchy and breathable, with a loose casual fit. Wash in normal temperature water to keep the print and color. Sizes run from S to XL.

A compact bi-fold women's wallet in pink, made from embossed genuine leather with a checkered pattern. It has a zipper pocket, a coin pocket, and a bill section that stays flat when stuffed. RFID-blocking material is meant to guard cards against unauthorized scanning.

A set of eight roll-up travel bags, three suitcase size and five carry-on size, for packing more into luggage. Air is pushed out by rolling, with no vacuum required. The bags are designed to shield clothing from insects, moths, dirt, mildew, and smells. They suit soiled items and coats.

A women's running shoe for moderate-mileage runners, with rearfoot and forefoot gel cushioning to soften impact. The outsole is designed for durability in high-impact areas. It has a removable sockliner that can make room for a medical orthotic. Imported, with a rubber sole and a low-top design.

A three-cube open-back storage organizer in white, designed to display or hold fabric bins. It stands about 44 inches tall and 16 inches wide, and each cube's interior measures 13.5 inches. The unit can be placed vertically or horizontally, and all hardware is included for easy assembly.

A women's vintage-style flap satchel in brown patent PU leather with a soft polyester lining. It has a top handle and a detachable metal chain strap, so it can be carried by hand, on the shoulder, or crossbody. A magnetic snap and zipper keep the interior secure, and it suits everyday and formal use.

A clear-back protective case for iPhone XR in blue accents, with a matte PC back and molded TPU bumper sides. It has cutouts that give access to buttons and ports without removing the case, and it supports wireless charging. The raised front edge helps protect the screen.

A short-sleeve black baby bodysuit with a retro 90s sitcom quote print, made from soft pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton. It has a snap crotch and a lap shoulder for easy dressing. The inks, fibers, and fasteners are certified by OEKO-TEX Standard 100, and it is printed in the USA.

A women's Western cowboy boot from Ariat in a silly brown and chocolate floral finish. It has a Duratread outsole. Sizing is 11 M US, and the listing offers few other details, so check the fit guide before buying.

specs.fits: 2016-2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD, all cabs

record.description: Electric running boards for 2016 to 2019 Nissan Titan and Titan XD trucks in all cab styles, finished in black. They extend automatically when the door opens and fold away when it closes, with a built-in LED light. Each side is rated for 600 pounds, and they are made in the USA.

An 18-inch sterling silver box chain for women, with a 0.8 mm width that feels delicate but sturdy. Its links are rhodium-plated to keep a bright shine and resist tarnish. It has a lobster claw clasp and is nickel-free, which the listing says helps avoid irritation.

A jumbo green shark-shaped pencil eraser for school, homework, and office use. The listing describes it as a fun way to erase big mistakes, and it is sold as a single eraser that also makes a gift for back to school.

A short-sleeve striped midi dress in navy, made from 100% polyester with stretch for a fitted, curvy silhouette. It has cap sleeves, a round neckline, and a hidden back zipper. The listing notes it runs slightly small, so consider sizing up if you fall between sizes.

A 2.2 gallon-per-minute chrome aerator for Delta Neo Style lavatory faucets. It has a 55/64 inch, 27 female thread to fit the faucet. The listing gives China as the country of origin and lists a phone number for technical assistance.

A men's rolled-sleeve button-down shirt in bright white, made from a lightweight linen and cotton blend for breathability. It has a narrow collar and a slim fit that is fitted at the shoulders and trim at the chest. The durable fabric can go in the washer and dryer.

A men's lightweight V-neck T-shirt in pampas, with a pocket and a fitted, slim silhouette. It is made from soft jersey slub cotton that feels light and comfortable. The shirt is an Amazon brand product from Goodthreads.

A black rubber ramp cleat mat measuring 3 by 4 feet and 1/8 inch thick, designed for non-slip footing on inclined paths. It works indoors or outdoors and suits boat docks, walkways, entryways, and high-traffic retail or hotel floors. The textured surface helps protect subfloors and resists slipping.

A white cotton throw blanket measuring 50 by 60 inches, with decorative fringe that is designed not to unravel in the wash. Its rustic, vintage-style look suits a couch, chair, or picnic. It can keep you warm on cold nights, and it works for camping or wrapping housewarming gifts.

A heavyweight aluminum angel food cake pan, 10 inches across, with a nonstick coating for easy release and cleanup. The heavy aluminum spreads heat gently and evenly for baking classic angel food cakes. It should be hand washed with mild detergent and is made in the USA.

A clear, slim case for iPhone 11 Pro Max with a hard plastic back and flexible silicone bumper. It is designed with shock-absorbing corners and raised bezels to protect the camera and screen. It is non-yellowing, has a grippy bumper, and works with wireless chargers.

A men's black oxford from ECCO with a bike-toe shape and blind-eyelet lacing. The moisture-wicking lining and comfort fiber system help keep feet ventilated. The one-component PU outsole includes a shock point for cushioning, and the double-stitched seams add durability.

A walk-through baby gate that expands to fit openings of 29 to 38 inches or 42 to 47 inches, and stands 30 inches tall. It is made of steel and uses pressure mounts with wall cups for added security. Extension kits in 4-inch and 12-inch widths are included. It also has safety-lock features.

A men's low-cut turf soccer shoe from adidas in core black with white and red accents. It has a regular fit and a Demonscale 3D-printed strike zone to help with ball contact. Designed for artificial turf, it suits players taking charge on the field.

A sand-colored triangular shade sail with 12-foot sides, made of 185 GSM high-density polyethylene. It blocks up to 95 percent of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. Install it at a 20 to 40 degree angle, with ropes and D-rings included for patios and gardens.

High-waisted flare palazzo pants in chakra blue, made of soft peachskin fabric with a 92 percent polyester and 8 percent spandex blend. The high waistband is designed to stay in place without digging in, and the wide-leg cut is flowy. Hand wash cold and hang dry.

A queen-size reversible comforter set in grey, with a comforter and two pillow shams. The comforter measures 88 by 92 inches and has a polyester fill with brushed microfiber. It offers all-season warmth, and its two solid colors give two looks. Machine wash in cold water on a gentle cycle.

A black LED headlamp with an 800-lumen XM-L T6 bulb, offering high, low, and strobe modes plus a zoom function. It weighs about 7.3 ounces and has an IP50 water rating, though the battery cover is not waterproof. The head tilts 90 degrees, and it runs on three AA batteries (not included).

A box of five lemon vanilla protein wafer crisps from Atkins, with sweet vanilla-covered wafers around a lemon filling. Each wafer offers 11 grams protein and 5 grams fiber, with 4 grams of net carbs and 1 gram of sugar per serving. It suits a low-carb lifestyle.

Women's flame-resistant mid-rise bootcut jeans from Ariat in oceanside wash, designed for work. They are made of cotton and Lycra for stretch and comfort, and they carry NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 ratings. The jeans have an embroidered back pocket detail and are built to withstand tough workdays.

Women's slip-on house slippers in grey with fleece lining and a high-density memory foam insole. The solid rubber sole is intended for indoor and outdoor use and offers traction. The wool-like plush upper is machine washable, and the listing notes these slippers may feel snug at first before stretching.

Men's relaxed straight-fit carpenter jeans in timber, made of soft, garment-washed lightweight cotton duck. They have deep pockets, a utility pocket, and a hammer loop, with a relaxed fit that allows bending and kneeling. Triple-stitched seams and brass rivets add durability, and the jeans are designed to fit over boots.

A matching his-and-hers wedding ring set with a cubic zirconia round-cut stone on the women's band and an 8 mm men's band. Both are made of 316L stainless steel that is nickel-free and does not tarnish. The set comes in a gift box and has a 60-day money-back guarantee.

A universal tripod mount for binoculars that lack a threaded tripod socket. It has a standard 1/4-20 screw thread, so it can attach to standard tripods. It fits a broad selection of binocular models, making it an easy add-on for steady viewing.

Women's open-toe spa thong slippers in black with terry cloth plush and a memory foam footbed. The skid-resistant rubber sole works indoors and outdoors, and the design is lightweight and easy to carry. Available in several sizes and wide widths, they are machine washable.

Women's moderate graduated compression socks in black, rated at 15 to 20 mmHg to help reduce swelling and fatigue. They suit everyday wear, travel, and long periods of sitting or standing. It has arch support and a seamless toe.

A women's loose-fit tunic top in solid black, with 3/4 roll-tab sleeves and a notch V-neck. It has a high-low hem and a flared look that drapes nicely in front, and it pairs with leggings or jeans. Its polyester and spandex blend is soft, lightweight, and stretchy.

A black luggage strap from Samsonite with no lock, made of ultra-rugged polypropylene and an ABS buckle built to handle baggage handling. It adjusts to fit bags up to 72 inches, and its distinct design and color make luggage easier to identify.

A women's western ankle bootie in taupe with a V cutout at the front, a stacked block heel, and an inner zip for easy on and off. It has a lightly padded footbed for walking, and it is made of vegan man-made materials. The heel measures about 1.5 inches.

A set of 69 Futurama-themed PVC stickers for laptops, backpacks, skateboards, luggage, bicycles, and more. The stickers range from about 1 to 3 inches each and suit children, teens, and adults. The listing says the seller guarantees its US-based products with a money-back promise.

Women's strappy sandals from Crocs in black and white, with a LiteRide foam insole that feels soft and light. The Croslite foam outsole is designed for durable, all-day support, and the flexible gore uppers feel comfortable from the first wear. The fit is relaxed, so order a size up.

A funny birthday card from Hallmark's Shoebox line, with modern lettering on a sunrise background. It measures about 5 by 7.2 inches and includes a matching envelope. The card is printed on high-quality paper from well-managed forests and is meant to get a laugh from friends or relatives.

Women's slip-on flats in gold cap and parrot green, designed for everyday wear, driving, and walking. The knit upper has a cotton lining, and the leather insole adds cushioning and arch support. The shoes are machine washable with the insole removed, and the listing advises sizing up.

A lightweight, classic-fit graphic T-shirt with a Switzerland and Swiss Alps theme, suited to travel, hiking, or as a souvenir gift. It has double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem. The design celebrates Swiss alpine country style.

A 25-foot natural cotton pipe wrap with foil backing that insulates, cushions, and reduces vibration on heating and cooling ducts. It has a Class A fire rating and needs no gloves, face mask, or goggles to install. The listing describes installation as easy.

An espresso and cappuccino machine with 20 bars of pressure and a brushed stainless-steel finish with colorful accents. Its steam nozzle froths milk for cappuccinos, and the nozzle adjusts to suit your taste. The removable water tank holds enough for six cups, and its drip tray is removable too.

A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike from Dynacraft's Air Zone Badlands line, with a freestyle rotor and deluxe paint finish. It has front and rear U-brakes, front and rear pegs for tricks, and 48-spoke wheels. The listing gives few other details, so check the sizing before buying.

A walnut jewelry armoire with a locking top lid, and eight pull-out drawers for storage. It has 16 double hooks, including necklace hooks on each door, and a top compartment with ring rolls and a vanity mirror. Made of solid wood, high-density fiberboard, and veneer, it requires no assembly.

An inflatable water park with a bounce castle, climbing wall, two slides, and a splash pool, sized about 18 by 17 by 9.5 feet. It is recommended for up to four children at a time. It is ASTM certified and made of PVC-coated 420D oxford fabric.

A white wired USB optical mouse with three buttons and 1000 DPI resolution, designed for office and home work. It plugs in without drivers, and the mouse has rainbow lighting. The 1.6-meter cord gives flexibility for placement, and the mouse measures about 4.4 by 2.5 by 1.6 inches.

Women's mid-calf waterproof winter boots from Sorel in dark gray and black. The suede uppers are seam-sealed and waterproof, with a soft shearling cuff and faux fur lining for warmth. The vulcanized rubber shell has a herringbone outsole and a 2.5 mm felt frost plug in the midsole.
Faux mink individual eyelash extensions in CC curl and 0.25 mm thickness, for salon use. The listing says the film strips leave no residue. Lengths range from 8 to 20 mm.

A two-pack of men's long-sleeve DryBlend T-shirts in sport grey, style G8400, in medium. They have a longer dropped shoulder, a straighter armhole, and shorter sleeves, plus a stay-cool fabric that wicks moisture. Neck tape reinforces the collar, and the cuffs include spandex for stretch and recovery.

A women's minimizer underwire bra in body beige tonal, sized 40D. Its supportive fabric and two-ply back help smooth and shape, and it is designed to reduce projection by up to 1 1/2 inches. The wider straps and open underwire add comfortable support, and the neckline offers balanced coverage.

A yellow folding wedge gymnastics mat measuring 48 inches, with a 15.5-degree incline for tumbling, stretching, yoga, and other training. It weighs about 11 pounds and has a trapezoidal shape that lets several mats stack for storage. It has high-density EPE foam stuffing and an anti-tear fabric.

A SwaddleMe WrapSack for babies aged 0 to 3 months, weighing 7 to 14 pounds. It can be worn with arms in, arms out, or one of each, and it has a bottom zipper for diaper changes. The soft wings fasten with hook and loop closures.

A small 14k solid white gold pendant in the shape of the number 1, with a laser-etched finish. It measures about 14.32 by 3.81 millimeters and is listed as hypoallergenic. The piece comes with a certificate of authenticity and a lifetime warranty from IceCarats.

A slim clear case for iPhone X and XS with D3O impact protection and bevelled edges that guard the phone's corners. It was drop tested up to 10 feet, with a UV-coated scratch-resistant finish. Precision cut-outs give access to all buttons and ports.

Women's grey and black winter ankle boots with a faux fur lining and padded collar for warmth. The vegan boots are made of faux leather with quilted side panels, and the rubber sole is designed for slip resistance on snowy streets. They suit outdoor use in fall and winter.

Men's slim-fit bootcut jeans from Amazon Essentials in black, with five-pocket styling and a bit of stretch to help the shape hold. They sit below the waist, are slim through the thigh, and widen at the ankle with a 17-inch leg opening.

A women's Timex Weekender watch with a reversible nylon slip-thru strap in blue and floral print. It has a round white dial with Arabic numerals, 24-hour time, and an Indiglo light. The silver-tone case is 38 mm, and the watch is water resistant to 30 meters.

Women's low-rise cargo scrub pants from KOI in black, with a drawstring waistband, several pockets, and a pocket sized for scissors. The Lindsey style has a D-ring on the left leg and adjustable toggles at the ankles, for a comfortable fit. Available in plus sizes such as XX-large petite.

A one-piece swimsuit for little girls in a dog-print design, sized 7T to 8T. It is made of 80 percent polyamide and 20 percent elastane, which dries fairly quickly and stretches with movement. The smooth fabric is gentle on sensitive skin and suits pool parties and beach days.

An officially licensed Marvel T-shirt featuring Miles Morales from the Spider-Verse series, with a climbing graphic. It is lightweight with a classic fit, and it has double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem.

A set of 10 bright washable hair chalks for temporary color. The chalks can be used alone or blended, and they wash out with shampoo and water. They work best on light hair, while dark or brown hair may need water applied first. They suit parties and cosplay.

Women's ultra-low no-show liners in black, sold as a three-pair pack in size 9 to 11. They have a breathable mesh top and a cushioned, ventilated sole, plus a silicone grip on the heel to help them stay in place. They are super soft.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver from Denon with 4K Ultra HD video support, including HDR and BT.2020, and 140 watts per channel. It has built-in Bluetooth and HEOS Link for wireless music streaming. An on-screen setup assistant helps connect your TV and tune surround sound.

A foldable black vocal booth with 2-inch high-density egg crate foam on its inside surfaces to reduce echoes and reflections. Inside it measures 12 by 14 by 16 inches, and it folds down to 16 by 16 by 6 inches for travel. It works on a mic stand or table.

specs.material: cotton canvas front, polyester mesh back

record.description: A structured, medium-profile cap from Carhartt in musk green, with a cotton canvas front and polyester mesh back. It has a pre-curved sandwich visor and a Carhartt patch on the front. The Force sweatband is designed to fight odor, and FastDry technology is intended to wick sweat.

A black laser projector from Epson with built-in Android TV and voice search through Google Assistant. It projects images up to 150 inches on a wall or screen, even with the lights on. An internal bass-reflex speaker provides sound, and a 3.5 mm stereo output is included.

Women's retro-style Nike Court Royale AC sneakers in black and white, made with a leather upper and traditional lacing for a locked-down fit. The Swoosh is in a contrasting tone that runs from heel to midfoot. The rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction, and a soft lining adds comfort.

A waterproof black nylon organizer bag for cables, chargers, and a USB drive. It has elastic loops for cables, mesh pockets for chargers, and a pad sleeve for a mini tablet up to 7.9 inches. It has two zippers and a detachable hand strap.

A hushed turquoise tote from Under Armour with a main compartment and an oversized wordmark zipper pull. The UA Storm finish is designed to be highly water-resistant, and it has double webbing straps for several carry options. It holds about 25 liters and measures 20.3 by 12.6 by 9.8 inches.

An updated Nike Air Mariah racer, originally released in the 1980s, now with modern tech and lightweight construction. It has a Flyknit upper with sock-like fit, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a durable rubber outsole.

A magnetic fiberglass door screen sized to fit openings up to 36 by 80 inches, with a 38 by 81 inch mesh. It includes hook-and-loop, push pins, and instructions for installation. Thickened webbing on all four sides, double-sewn top middle, and windproof hook-and-loop hasps help keep it in place.

A teal blue shaggy area rug measuring 5 by 8 feet, with a fluffy pile about 1.57 inches tall. Anti-slip dots on the bottom help keep it from sliding, though it should be kept dry underneath. A dense sponge layer adds softness and sound absorption, suited to living rooms and bedrooms.

A men's long-sleeve peasant henley shirt in blue, with a mandarin collar, roll-tab sleeves, and buttons to the chest. It is made of an 80 percent cotton and 20 percent polyester oxford fabric that holds its shape after washing. Machine or hand wash in cold water and hang dry.

A 3 by 10 foot putting training mat with realistic turf that feels like a real putting green. The putting surface inside the border measures about 2 by 8.5 feet, and the mat includes two holes with flags. It has a padded rubber base and works indoors or outdoors.

A manual focus 35mm f/1.2 lens for APS-C mirrorless cameras with a Canon EOS-M mount, finished in black. Its wide f/1.2 aperture lets in plenty of light for shooting in dim conditions. The crescent-shaped focus ring is designed to feel comfortable, and multi-layer coating helps reduce scratches.

A set of two ivory frosted plastic flameless candles with a moving flame, designed for outdoor and indoor use. The candles are waterproof, and they run on batteries with a remote control and timer. The frosted shell becomes more transparent when lit and resists melting.

Men's functional thermal base layer set in black and blue, sized L/XL, as a shirt or long johns. The elastic sports fabric is designed for warmth, breathability, and moisture absorption. It has three-dimensional elastic zones for freedom of movement and double-seamless construction, and it suits skiing, hiking, and cycling.

A replacement USB charging cable with a 2.0 mm DC tip for Mini S530 wireless earbuds. It charges from a wall adapter, laptop, power bank, or car charger. It is not compatible with B&O Earset 2 or Blue Parrot headsets.
A 13-inch cube storage box in 100% polyester with a felt dog appliqué on the front. It fits most cube shelving units, and a front tab lets kids and adults pull it out easily.

A grey insulated lunch bag with a 15-liter double-layer design, so foods can be kept separate on upper and lower levels. It measures about 9.5 by 8 by 10.5 inches and expands to 11 inches wide. The thickened, seamless PEVA liner resists leaks and keeps food warm or cold.

A set of four handcrafted stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line, made in England. They are safe for use in the oven, microwave, freezer, and dishwasher. The bowls come in a multicolor pattern, and the listing notes that each is made by skilled artisans.

A corrugated cardboard cat scratcher shaped as a chaise, with catnip infused between each layer. It works as a corrugate block for long-lasting scratching, a floor scratcher for crouching, and a lounge. The textured surface mimics tree bark, and the listing says it supports healthy nail growth.

A women's sleeveless lace fit-and-flare midi dress in navy, size medium. It is partially lined and has a contemporary fit that runs small, so the listing suggests considering a larger size. Its size chart lists medium as US 6 to 8.

A cherry blossom bath and shower gel from L'Occitane in an 8.4 fluid ounce bottle. It gently cleanses the skin and leaves a delicate floral scent after rinsing. The product is listed as suitable for sensitive skin, and the listing suggests lathering on wet skin before rinsing.
A WIX 57502XP replacement oil filter for vehicle engines. It weighs about 0.75 pounds in its package, which measures 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches. The listing says it is made in China.

A large 82.7 by 78.7-inch beach blanket made of 100% nylon, sized to fit four to eight adults. It is sand-resistant, water-resistant, and quick-drying, and it folds to about 7.9 by 3.9 by 1.6 inches. The blanket weighs 12 ounces and comes with a storage bag for easy carrying.

A kids' lace-up boat shoe from Sperry's Cruise line in navy and grey, designed to look dressy. It has a leather-like upper, a memory foam footbed for comfort and stability, and a cupsole with rubber outsole for traction. The 360-degree lacing system provides a snug fit.

Women's classic short rubber-logo boot from UGG in black, with a soft suede upper and a UGGpure lining and insole. It has a Treadlite outsole and a rubber UGG logo printed on the front shaft. The listing says the lining and insole are 17 mm thick.

A glossy pink vinyl apron that is waterproof and ultra lightweight, suited to cooking, cleaning, gardening, and pet grooming. It has adjustable poly-webbing neck and waist straps and long waist ties that fasten behind the back. The vinyl surface wipes clean easily and is recyclable.

A full-motion wall mount bracket for most 13 to 30 inch TVs and monitors, rated for TVs up to 33 pounds. It supports VESA 75 and 100 millimeter patterns and extends up to 14 inches from the wall. It tilts 15 degrees, swivels, and rotates 360 degrees.

Fan-shaped hanging corner shelves in distressed dark brown wood, suspended on jute rope. Each board has an 11-inch radius and is 0.7 inches thick, with a torch-finished surface. The rustic farmhouse design suits entryways, kitchens, bathrooms, and bedrooms, and the shelves make a good gift.

A set of coordinating cotton dresses for baby girls in the 12 to 18 month size, featuring a blueberry print. The 100 percent cotton fabric feels soft and gentle on delicate skin. Suited to everyday wear, the set is offered as an affordable value pack.

A pack of 50 Wee-Wee odor control dog pads with Febreze freshness, sized 22 by 23 inches for dogs of all sizes. The rapid-drying top layer helps prevent tracking, and a gel layer traps liquid. A built-in attractant draws dogs to the pad, which can help with potty training.

A two-pack of collapsible wall-mounted drying racks that fold away when not in use. Each rack has a metal bar that holds several hanging garments, which lets you air-dry clothes in a laundry room, utility closet, closet, boat, or RV. The listing says the racks maximize closet space.

An 18 by 84 inch mesh nylon banner reading OVERSIZE LOAD, meant for wide-load vehicles. It has heavy-duty brass grommets for attaching to the front or back of most vehicles. The material is breathable and tear and UV resistant, and the listing describes the product as professional grade.

A set of 48 neon green floating golf balls for water practice, pond play, and pool fun. Each ball has a two-piece construction, 432 dimples, and a 90 compression injection-molded Surlyn cover. A carry bag is included for storage.

A white countertop dishwasher with six place settings and an Energy Star rating. It offers six wash cycles and a delay start of two, four, six, or eight hours. It connects to most kitchen faucets with a universal adapter and quick-connect, and has an LED display for remaining time.

A DIY cake pop maker toy that lets kids bake Butterfinger-style cake pops in about 30 seconds without an oven. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating tools, and a recipe booklet. Food ingredients are not included, and the toy is recommended for ages six and older.

A swivel faucet aerator with a 720-degree rotation that lets you direct water to every corner of the sink without splashing. It offers two water flow modes, a soft setting for washing hands and a strong sprayer setting for quickly cleaning items. It has a solid brass build.

Men's regular-fit golf shoe from adidas in grey, green, and black, with lace closure and a mesh and synthetic upper. It has a Bounce midsole and Boost cushioning in the heel. The listing says the upper contains at least 50 percent recycled content, as part of Primegreen materials.

A natural-colored Carolina straw hat from Stetson & Dobbs in an Outback style, with a vented crown for airflow. It is sized XL. The listing gives few other details, so check the measurements before ordering.

A two-pack of clear acrylic apothecary jars, a 15-ounce and a 20-ounce, for cotton swabs, cotton balls, bath salts, and other bathroom items. Each jar has a removable acrylic lid and a wide mouth for easy access. They are easy to clean and come with chalkboard label stickers.

specs.features: card slot, kickstand, swivel belt clip

record.description: A rose gold hybrid case for Samsung Galaxy On5 with a brushed metal texture, card slot, and kickstand. Its two-layer design has a rubberized interior and hardened exterior for shock absorption and scratch resistance. A swivel belt clip locks in place and rotates 180 degrees.

A painless electric facial hair remover for women with dual stainless steel blades and a 180 Pro generation II motor. It is designed for face, lips, cheeks, and chin, and the listing says it works on fine and coarse hair. It is portable and lasts about two years.

A double-layer camping hammock in reversible black or orange, made of 210T nylon with no seams. It has a maximum load of 880 pounds and measures 8.9 by 4.6 feet, enough for two large adults. Tree straps are 9.8 feet long, and setup is quick enough for one person.

A hooded reindeer costume for dogs in medium, perfect for Christmas or winter-themed parties. It closes with Velcro at the neck and chest. The listing gives two different fit measurements, so check the size chart before ordering.

A height-adjustable desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top and tilt from 13 to 45 degrees. Dual motors raise it from 29 to 49 inches, and an LED touch panel includes memory buttons, a child lock, and two USB charging ports. It supports up to 165 pounds.

A 10-piece set of pirate figurines, including five pirates, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X marks the spot flag. The figures are about 1 to 2.5 inches tall and suit imaginative play and party favors. Made without phthalates or lead, for ages 3 and up.

Blue performance insoles for men's shoes in the 9 to 10.5 size range. They are built for walking, running, cross training, and casual use. The contoured neutral arch suits most foot types, and gel pads in the heel and forefoot add cushioning without bulk. A Hydrologix treatment helps keep feet dry.

A mid-century modern accent armchair in azure, upholstered in soft polyester fabric with subtle piped trim. It has a curved back, cut-out silhouette, and gentle recline, sitting on dark walnut-stained wood legs with non-marking caps. Dense foam padding adds comfort, and the chair suits living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or entryways.

A round two-tier stainless steel lunch box container with a white twist lid, designed to keep soup and hot food. Its vacuum-tight seal helps prevent leaks and spills, and locked clips fasten each tier together. The container is BPA-free and safe for the dishwasher and freezer.
Women's printed knit Bermuda pajama shorts from HUE in chambray blue, featuring a print from HUE's New York studio. They have a comfort elastic waistband and a relaxed fit with a 10.5-inch inseam.

A fully articulated 6-inch Falcon action figure from Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War, made by Bandai's S.H.Figuarts line. Detachable wing gears convert it into flying mode. It comes with extra hands, an optional head, a backpack for wings, holographic wings, and two weapons. It is for ages 15 and up.

A red 3D-designed mesh decal for the radiator grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger, made in Korea. It attaches with double-sided adhesive tape and is intended to give the front bumper a stylish look. One set is included per order.

A stylized Thor vinyl Funko Pop figure from Avengers: Endgame, standing about 3.75 inches tall. It is designed as a collectible for display alongside other Endgame figures. The listing notes that the eye paint differences are subtle and are best seen outside the packaging.

Training sweatpants inspired by My Hero Academia, styled after Izuku and Tsuyu Asui, in XX-large. The listing describes the cotton as soft and comfortable, and the pants are intended for daily wear, cosplay, Halloween, and theme parties.

A 9-foot beige table umbrella with a 100 percent polyester canopy that is waterproof, fade resistant, and easy to clean. It provides 48 inches of shade for tables with four to six chairs. The steel pole is powder coated, and it opens by crank with a push-button tilt.

A kids' flower-growing kit with a tin planter that children can decorate with paints they can mix into new hues. It includes zinnia, marigold, and cosmos seed packets, a plant liner, coconut fiber pucks, and stake holders to keep the garden organized. Instructions help children learn how flowers grow.

A men's hiking shoe from Merrell's Moab 2 Vent line in walnut, with a performance suede and mesh upper. A bellows tongue with closed-cell foam keeps moisture and debris out, and a rubber toe cap adds protection. It has a breathable mesh lining and a Vibram TC5-plus sole with 5 mm lugs.

A navy hardside carry-on suitcase from Ben Sherman, measuring 20 inches. It has four multi-directional spinner wheels and a durable ABS shell with corner guards. The fully lined interior includes zippered organization pockets and a garment restraint panel, and the telescoping handle extends to 41 inches.

A women's lightweight classic blazer with a draped open front, in red and size small. It comes in long-sleeve, 3/4-sleeve, and ruched styles, and it suits school, office, casual, dating, or party occasions. Hand wash cold and hang or line dry.

A 120-piece fort building kit with 75 sticks that are about 15 inches long and 45 solid balls, 23 blue and 22 green. Rods twist into the balls to build tunnels, tents, castles, and other forts, and a bed sheet can be added for a hideaway. It is made of plastic for ages 5 and up.

Rechargeable heated memory foam insoles with three adjustable temperature settings and a power display on the button. The 2400 mAh battery is designed to keep the heat steady as charge drops, with a smart chip for thermostatic control. The insoles offer neutral arch support and cushioning, and suit walking and winter wear.

Women's metal aviator sunglasses from Jessica Simpson with a 60 mm lens, shown in gold-tone with a logo temple and tortoise tips. The impact-resistant polycarbonate lens has a protective coating that the listing says shields the eyes from UV rays. The frame has adjustable nose pads.

Men's compression sports tights from Defender in size large, made of 92 percent polyester and 8 percent spandex. They are designed to be worn under jerseys and fit like a second skin for sports. The compression fit is meant to support muscles and circulation, with UPF 30 sun protection.

A men's heavyweight car coat from Amazon Essentials in black, made of thick, warm wool-blend twill with a soft, cozy feel. It has a roomy fit through the chest and waist and a button-front closure. This size is small.

A pack of 12 large silver metallic foil gift bows, each about 4.5 inches in diameter. They have self-adhesive backing for easy application to gifts. The bows are designed to coordinate with other curly ribbon bows and ribbon sold by The Gift Wrap Company.

An orange Bluetooth FM transmitter and car adapter with a compact 1.6 by 1.6 inch body and four buttons. It has dual USB ports with QC 3.0 fast charging and hands-free calling. It can also play music from a USB drive or TF card.

A red oriole jelly feeder from Perky-Pet with a 32-ounce capacity. The inverted bottle keeps jelly fresh, clean, and dry, and an internal stirrer dispenses the right amount. The bottle is easy to clean and can be swapped with most standard 32-ounce jelly jars.

A king-size sheet set from Sferra's Grande Hotel collection, with grey satin stitching. It includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases, made in Italy from 200-thread-count Egyptian cotton percale. Machine wash warm on a gentle cycle with non-chlorine bleach, and tumble dry on low until slightly damp.

A pack of ten 42 mm white festoon LED bulbs for car interior dome, map, and trunk lights. Each bulb has 16 super bright 3528 SMD chips and is rated for 50,000 working hours. They are plug and play; rotating a dead bulb 180 degrees may fix polarity.
A gray boat seat from Millennium Marine that mounts to most boat pedestals. It measures 18 by 21 by 6 inches, weighs 8 pounds, and is rated for 400 pounds. The seat carries a three-year warranty.

A fuchsia semi-permanent hair dye from MANIC PANIC that is ready to use without developer. It can be mixed with other MANIC PANIC colors or combined with the Pastelizer for softer pastel hues. The formula is ammonia-free, vegan, and cruelty-free, and the color fades in four to six weeks.

A women's mid-ankle hiking boot from Timberland's White Ledge line in dark brown, with leather uppers and shock-absorbing cushioning. The rubber lug outsole is made for traction on trails, and the boot is styled for outdoor wear. The listing describes the boot as waterproof.

An Under Armour Freedom Blitzing cap in academy blue with red accents and a classic fit. It has a pre-curved visor, structured front panels, and foam padding on the front panel. The Microthread fabric is designed to dry quickly and not absorb sweat.
A red 0.7 cubic foot microwave from Daewoo, with a turntable included. It is model KOR07R3ZER. The listing gives few other details, so check the product specifications before buying.

A handmade royal blue flower crown headband designed for weddings, festivals, and photo shoots. Its 19-centimeter diameter fits most heads, and the elegant design suits brides, bridesmaids, and flower girls. The listing describes it as eye-catching and charming.

specs.features: cup holder, headphone hook, cable tray

record.description: A black Z-shaped gaming desk with a carbon fiber surface that measures 42.5 by 23.6 by 27.56 inches and holds up to 280 pounds. It includes a cup holder, headphone hook, cable management tray, and two speaker holders. The curved design is intended to give ergonomic comfort.

A 24K gold extra-long 1-inch curling iron from Hot Tools, with a barrel two inches longer than many standard irons. It reaches up to 430 degrees and has a rheostat temperature control and a rotating cool tip. A heat-resistant mat is included to protect countertops.

High-visibility orange impact gloves from Mad Grip in large, designed with a breathable knit and grip injection technology for precise handling of large and small parts. Seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas is meant to extend durability and dampen vibration. The gloves are machine washable.

A blue 50cc two-stroke kids' dirt bike with an air-cooled, EPA-approved engine and a pull start. Its Chromalloy frame is built to carry a growing child, and it has real outdoor rubber tires, telescopic front forks, and standard safety features. It suits wet and dry conditions.

A black 6000 mAh battery case for iPhone 6, 6s, 7, and 8 that adds power. Its sync-through design lets you charge the case and phone with an existing cable and sync data to a computer without removing the case. It also supports earphones and wireless Bluetooth headphones.

A rose gold glitter case for iPhone XR with a hard outer shell and clear TPU interior. It offers full front and back coverage, raised bezels, and reinforced large cut-outs for buttons, ports, and camera. The bling finish is designed not to shed glitter onto fingers.

A purple PU leather wallet case for Samsung Galaxy S20 with a 6.2-inch screen. It has nine card slots, a zipper coin pocket, and two side pockets for IDs and cash. A magnetic closure and kickstand are included, and a TPU base is designed not to scratch the phone.

A black knitted polyethylene leaf net cover for a 16 by 32 foot rectangular pool. It goes on the winter cover before leaves fall, and it prevents decaying leaves from collecting on the cover or in the water. The reinforced tie-down loops help secure it.

A set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, with a standard 7/16-inch stem. The patented design aims to roll quietly over cables and is listed as safe for hardwood, laminate, tile, and carpet floors. Its elastic urethane wheels glide smoothly and quietly.

A refurbished Apple iPhone 8 in space gray with 64 GB of storage, locked to AT&T and not compatible with other carriers. The listing says the battery was tested and guaranteed to have at least 80 percent capacity. It includes a certified charger and cable but no SIM card.

A white floppy-brimmed oversized costume bonnet from Forum Novelties, sized one size for most teens and adults. It adds a touch of Americana to a costume. The listing says it is also available in red and black.

A gray Singer Heavy Duty 4452 sewing machine with a metal frame and 32 built-in stitches, including basic, stretch, and decorative options. It features a one-step automatic buttonhole and an automatic needle threader. A heavy-duty accessory kit is included for garments, crafts, and home decor projects.
Men's Chewbacca socks from Stance in green, size large. They have a seamless toe closure, arch support, and reinforced heel and toe areas. The listing gives few other details.

A set of six 7-milliliter color-changing gel nail polishes that shift shade with the temperature of your nails, packaged in a gift box. The set suits home manicures and salon-style nail art, and the listing describes it as a holiday and birthday gift option.

A four-pack of red 10-foot ratchet tie-down straps with 1-inch webbing and a 900-pound break strength, each rated for up to 300 pounds of workload. They include metal ratchet buckles, PVC-coated S hooks, and a mesh storage bag. Suited for securing a canoe, kayak, motorcycle, mountain bike, or boat.

A set of three 5-ounce tall double-wall glass espresso cups that keep hot drinks warm and cold drinks cool. They work for espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, tea, and iced drinks such as ice cream. The modern clear design also makes them a gift option for friends and family.

A forest green liquid silicone case for iPhone X and XS with a microfiber inner lining. It covers all four edges and has 1 mm raised bezels around the screen and camera to help reduce impact and scratches. The soft, smooth silicone is one of 13 colors available.

A blue and grey neoprene drawstring sleeve that insulates bottles for travel, cycling, climbing, and other sports. It fits 22-ounce long-neck bottles and reportedly fits 16 to 20-ounce bottles. It can hang from a backpack with its buckle design.

A pack of 100 individually sealed 1 ml plastic syringes with caps, sterile and odorless. The clear scale marks help with measuring and dispensing liquids such as essential oils and perfume. The caps protect the tip and prevent leaks, and the syringes suit lab, garden, and refill work.

A marble-pattern TPU case for iPhone 7, iPhone 8, and iPhone SE 2020 with a 360-degree rotating ring kickstand. The IMD printed design is intended to stay vivid and not fade, and the case is designed to be shockproof. The kickstand helps you stand the phone up for watching videos.

A 60-inch vintage oak industrial home office desk with X-shaped metal legs and a metal support frame. Its desktop is 1.18 inches thick and rated for up to 330 pounds, and four adjustable feet help keep it level. Made of metal and high-grade MDF, it has room for monitors and laptops.

A men's tungsten carbide wedding band from King Will, 8 millimeters wide, with a rose gold line and a black and silver brushed finish. It has a comfort fit. The ring is described as durable, anti-scratch, and hypoallergenic, and it comes with a jewelry box and lifetime warranty.

A chrome 8.5-inch Moen Velocity rainshower showerhead with two functions, a full rinse, and a concentrated spray option. Its self-pressurizing Immersion technology is said to deliver three times more spray power than most rainshowers. The chrome finish is reflective, and the head is designed for hassle-free installation.

A two-piece set of federal blue pocket mitts from Ritz Royale Collection, made of 100% cotton terry cloth. Each measures 8.5 by 7.75 inches and works as an oven mitt or a pot holder. Machine wash in cold water and tumble dry low.

A beige day-and-night bunion corrector with breathable elastic fabric and a built-in gel separator that gently guides the toe into alignment over time. Its smooth, snug design is intended to avoid rubbing. It suits men and women seeking non-surgical relief.

A black heavy-duty front bumper license plate bracket from Red Hound Auto for 2006 to 2008 Ford F-150 and Lincoln Mark LT trucks. It is made of automotive-grade thermoplastic and includes license plate screws. The listing describes it as a direct-fit replacement, and it lists several reference part numbers.

A 4-ounce vitamin C facial toner with witch hazel, designed as a face spray to prep skin before serums and moisturizers. The formula includes MSM, vitamin E, and glycolic acid, and the listing says it helps with pores and oil. It is marketed for sensitive, dry, and combination skin.

A 66-inch L-shaped corner desk in vintage wood with an X crossbar for stability and adjustable leg pads. The top is 1.5 cm thick and can hold up to 440 pounds, with room for three or more monitors. It has 27 inches of space underneath for legs, a CPU, or storage.

A compact carbon fiber key organizer that holds up to 20 keys and includes a SIM tool and bottle opener. The listing says its locking system keeps keys from loosening, so you do not need to retighten it daily. Video instructions are included to help with assembly.
An 11-by-6-inch airtight storage pouch lined with carbon, intended to keep odors inside. It is sized to fit in a backpack or be carried by hand, and the listing says it is very well made.

A 12-pound twin-size weighted blanket measuring 48 by 72 inches, filled with glass beads in a seven-layer structure to keep them from leaking. The listing says it simulates a gentle hug for sleep. It suggests choosing a weight of about 7 to 12 percent of body weight.

A pack of two baby blue decorative throw pillow covers, 18 by 18 inches, with 3mm sequins on one side and soft satin on the other. Each cover has a zipper and is sized for 18-inch inserts, which are not included. They suit weddings, Christmas, and everyday decor.

A cubic zirconia bridal ring set in a pear-shaped teardrop design, size 6, with a width of 1.1 centimeters and weight of 4 grams. It is presented in a gift box with a favor bag. The set suits weddings, anniversaries, proms, and other occasions.

A 17 by 12 inch stainless steel cooling rack, oven-safe and designed to fit most standard ovens and sheet pans. Its grid pattern allows airflow without letting cookies fall through, and it is meant to resist warping. It can lift food above grease on a sheet pan and is easy to wash.

A 1-ounce black pigmented tattoo ink from Dynamic Colors, described as vibrant and healing true. It is made in the USA and is intended for all types of tattoo art. The listing gives few other details.

A brown synthetic leather adjustable crossbody purse strap with gold metal hardware. It extends from about 43 to 49 inches including snap hooks, and the band is 0.7 inches wide with double-layer taping. The soft strap is designed as a replacement for cross body bags and purses.

An 80-count bottle of Unisom SleepTabs, a nighttime sleep aid with doxylamine succinate, taken as one tablet per dose. The listing says it helped people fall asleep 33 percent faster than placebo in a clinical study and is non-habit forming when used as directed.

A set of six 12-ounce stemless champagne flutes made of 100 percent Tritan plastic, which the listing says is BPA-free and shatterproof. The clear flutes look like glass and are dishwasher safe. They are offered as an alternative to glass champagne glasses for mimosas and prosecco.

A short, curly synthetic headband wig in dark red, with the headband attached for an easy fit. It measures 10 inches long and suits head circumferences from 21.5 to 25 inches. The drawstring tightens to secure the wig, and it is suited to work, travel, parties, and everyday wear.

A 100-inch 16:9 PVC matte projector screen with a stand and carry bag. It has a 1.1 gain and 160-degree viewing angle, and its wrinkle-free surface is easy to clean. The bottom-roll design unfolds into place without screws for a quick setup, and the stable tripod supports it.

A 10-inch standard French whisk made in the USA from 18/8 stainless steel wires. The listing says it is NSF approved, has the right weight and size for mixing, and is dishwasher safe. It is designed to fit bowls and saucepans well for cooking.

A blue lion head vinyl decal from JS Artworks, measuring 3.7 by 5 inches. It is made in the USA from high-quality vinyl that can be removed without damage or residue, and installation instructions are included. The listing describes it as brand new.

A two-sided Keia's Treehouse playset from Puppy Dog Pals, with a 3-inch poseable Keia figure and seven pieces in total. It includes a bouncy chair, grooming brush, food and water bowls, a flower shower, and a bridge. The kid-powered elevator and spinning lookout let children replay scenes from the show.

A pack of 25 binder pages with four poly sleeves each, holding 100 CDs or DVDs in total. The non-woven liner is intended to protect discs from scratches, and the pages fit standard three-ring binders. The sleeves help protect discs from fingerprints, smudges, or scratches.

A Bunn AXIOM-15-3 coffee brewer that runs on 120-volt, 60-hertz single-phase power. The listing identifies it as a coffee maker made in the United States, with package dimensions of about 27 by 56 by 61 centimeters. It is listed as a single package.

Men's red waterproof insulated snow pants from FREE SOLDIER, sized medium with a 32-inch length. They have a polyester shell and lining with 120 grams of insulation and a durable water repellent finish. The listing describes them as snowproof, windproof, and breathable, with zipper pockets for skiing and snowboarding.

A hand-painted miniature sloth figurine on a tree, from Enesco's Jim Shore Heartwood Creek collection. It is made of stone resin and measures about 4.25 by 1.5 by 2.88 inches. The design uses traditional quilt patterns and folk-art motifs, and it comes in an individual box.

A 2.5-inch wired fall plaid ribbon in warm orange, green, and red, sold as 10 yards on a reel. It is made of woven polyester with metallic and nylon threads, and its monofilament wire edges hold loops and bows in shape. It suits fall décor, wreaths, and DIY projects.

A men's classic fit long-sleeve plaid button-down shirt from Cinch in yellow, sized small. It has extra-long sleeves and tails, a single open front pocket, and button-down front, cuffs, and collar. The fit includes extra room in the shoulders, chest, and body.

A right-handed 5-string bass guitar from Ibanez in brown, with a spalted maple top over a mahogany body. It has a maple neck, rosewood fretboard with white dot inlays, medium frets, and a B15 bridge. The listing gives few other details.

A 33-fluid-ounce fragrance-free body wash from Aveeno Skin Relief, enriched with oat to soothe dry, itchy skin. The formula is soap-free and dye-free, and the listing says it is allergy-tested and suitable for sensitive skin. It cleanses while aiming not to disrupt the skin's natural moisture barrier.

Organic cotton zip-up footed sleepers from Burt's Bees Baby in the Moonlight Clouds print, sized newborn to 9 months. They have a loose fit, a diagonal zip front for easy diaper changes, and non-slip footies. The cotton is GOTS certified and breathable.

A compact 18-watt USB-C fast charger from AUKEY with USB Power Delivery 3.0 and a foldable plug. It is about one inch thick and suited to home, office, and travel charging for iPhone 12 models and other USB-C devices. Built-in safeguards protect against excessive current, overheating, and overcharging.

A set of three nickel-plated candle stands for unity candle lighting or romantic décor, with a double-heart design and rhinestone accents. The large stand fits a 3-inch pillar candle and is about 4.5 inches tall, while the two taper stands are 4 inches tall. It is part of the Sparkling Love collection.

A men's black leather driving loafer from Lacoste with a flexible moccasin construction and an embossed crocodile logo. It slips on easily and has a cushioned foam insole for comfort and shock absorption.

A two-seat convertible loveseat with a hardwood frame, two pillows, and foldable armrests that can become a sleeper bed. Its backrest adjusts across five angles from 90 to 180 degrees, and the seat is designed to be deep. It ships from a US warehouse.

A men's burgundy graphic T-shirt from Riot Society in X-large, featuring a Geisha flower garden design. It is made of 100 percent cotton with a soft wash feel. The shirt is machine washable and has a tagless neck label.

A deluxe Buzz Lightyear costume from Disney Store for toddlers in size 2T. It includes a full bodysuit, soft fabric wings, gloves, and a hat, with glitter accents and padding at the knees. The back has self-stick fabric for easy on and off.

A set of three reusable 304 stainless steel straws for yerba mate, tea, and cocktails, with a 1 mm filter base that will not clog. Their metal construction helps gauge how hot a drink is before sipping. They are portable and come with a cleaning brush.

A 160-page summer learning workbook for children moving from fourth to fifth grade, covering language arts, math, and science. Each day's activities take about 15 minutes and review the previous year while previewing the next grade. The book includes stickers, flash cards, an award certificate, and an answer key.

A two-pack of hand-woven gray cotton rope baskets in 10- and 12-inch sizes, for indoor plants, crafts, toys, or towels. The baskets are suited to plants from flowers to succulents and herbs, and they are offered in 18 designs with colors including black and white.

A men's black Bulova analog-quartz dress watch with a stainless steel case measuring 44.5 millimeters. It has a leather alligator-embossed strap and a mineral crystal. The watch is water resistant to 30 meters, which the listing says means splashes or brief immersion only.

A floating neoprene sunglass strap that works as a retainer or lanyard for men, women, and kids. It measures 19 inches long and 1 inch wide. The strap is designed to float on water, and it comes in colors from black and gray to bright pink.

A set of four clear plastic storage bins with built-in handles, sized for desk drawers, filing cabinets, and closet shelves. They are open-topped so you can see what is inside, and they hold notes, pens, pencils, staples, and small electronics. The bins are easy to carry from shelf to desktop.

A pack of two cream and black mixed chenille pillow covers, 18 by 18 inches, with an invisible zipper closure. The plush velvet-look fabric is designed to mix with pillows in fur, cotton, linen, or leather. Inserts are not included, and they are machine washable on a gentle cycle.

specs.filling: natural grain and dried French lavender

record.description: A 20-inch plush toy from Warmies, filled with natural grain and dried French lavender and heated in the microwave for soothing warmth. The listing says it meets U.S. safety standards for all ages and suggests it as a bedtime buddy or stress-relief companion.

A 12-piece set of soft foam building blocks in primary colors for toddlers. The blocks help children develop motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and color recognition. The set is GREENGUARD Gold certified and meets CPSIA, CA-117, and ASTM F963 toy safety standards, with CertiPUR foam.

A women's lightweight water-repellent backpack from Vera Bradley in the Tossed Posies print, designed for travel and everyday use. It has a padded laptop compartment, a trolley sleeve for luggage, side mesh pockets, and a ventilated shoe compartment. Inside are a large zip pocket, slip pockets, and pen slips.

A slim matte TPU case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max, sized for the 6.5-inch model only. It adds little bulk, leaves wireless charging working, and offers 360-degree protection. The flexible material is easy to put on and take off, with a smooth matte texture.

A women's lightweight crewneck sweater from Amazon Essentials in black, sized large, with a classic fit that allows easy movement. It is knit from soft, light yarn and has ribbing at the collar, cuffs, and hem.

A 60-capsule iodine supplement from Divine Bounty, providing 250 micrograms of iodine from raw sea kelp grown in the USA. The listing describes it as a thyroid support supplement with no harmful additives. Iodine is described as an essential trace mineral for normal body function.

A black expandable 40-liter carry-on backpack from Vancropak for weekend and business trips, with a water-resistant body. It meets the maximum IATA size for overhead and under-seat storage, and its TSA 180-degree zipper closure is designed for quicker security checks. It has hideaway shoulder straps.

A 75-milliliter tube of Mars Black acrylic paint from Sargent Art that is opaque and vibrant and dries to a waterproof finish. The tube is peggable and conforms to ASTM D 4236 for safety and non-toxicity. It is made in India and comes in 24 colors.

An extra long red and white striped Santa hat from amscan, measuring 32 inches and fitting most teens and adults. It is made of faux fur and felt with trimmed fur and a pom-pom topper. The listing describes it as soft and comfortable for Christmas.

A rose gold 28-inch expandable ABS checked suitcase from Kenneth Cole Reaction with eight multi-directional spinner wheels. It expands by two additional inches and has a retractable trolley handle. The interior has zippered organization pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint panel.

A two-pack of men's short-sleeve white pocket T-shirts from Dickies in extra large. They are made of pre-shrunk cotton, with a left chest pocket and a small exterior Dickies logo. The tagless back neck label and taped neck and shoulder seams are designed for comfort and longer wear.

A black vanity stool with a padded cream-colored cushion and slightly flared solid wood legs, made of thickened MDF and solid pine. It is rated for up to 250 pounds and is designed to stay steady, with high-density sponge padding for comfort during long sitting.

A navy kitchen island from Crosley Furniture's Madison collection with a 1.5-inch solid wood butcher block top. It includes two smooth-glide drawers and three cabinets, plus casters or feet so it can be moved or kept stationary. Built from solid hardwood and birch veneers with brushed nickel hardware.

A set of 60 fine-tip permanent markers in assorted bright colors from Shuttle Art. The quick-drying ink is listed as waterproof, smear-proof, and fade-resistant, and the markers work on plastic, wood, stone, metal, and glass. They conform to ASTM D-4236 and EN71 and are labeled for ages 3 and up.

Grey Golden Goose Superstar sneakers in size 8 US, with a leather upper made of 89 percent cowhide and 11 percent polyester. The soft rubber sole is designed to cushion each step, and the upper features a glitter blue star. The listing calls them breathable and lightweight.

A men's grey and white slip-on sneaker from Quiksilver in size 13 M US. The upper is made of no-sew mesh and welded to molded structural underlays for a performance fit. The listing offers few other details.

A white marine digital media receiver from Sony with built-in Bluetooth and two 6.5-inch dual cone speakers. It has an IPX5 water-resistant design and a front USB port for iOS and MSC or MTP devices. USB playback supports MP3, WMA, AAC, WAV, and FLAC, and it is SiriusXM ready.

A bare-board 150-watt switching power supply module that converts AC 100 to 240 volts into DC 24 volts for industrial control systems. It uses a double-sided PCB design and includes over-voltage, over-current, and short-circuit protection. The listing describes it as stable and reliable.

An 8 by 10 foot silver and black Moroccan ombre area rug from Safavieh's Adirondack collection. It is machine-woven from stain-resistant synthetic fibers with a virtually non-shedding 0.45-inch pile. It is suited to kids and pets, and cleaning means vacuuming and blotting stains.

A black faux fur throw blanket from Bedsure, 50 by 60 inches, with plush faux fur on the front and sherpa fleece on the back. Its understated tie-dye pattern is meant to serve as a décor focal point. The listing says it mimics the feel of mink.
Women's Avelini slide sandal from Ted Baker in magnificent yellow, size 8.5 regular US. The listing has no product details beyond the name and color, so check the fit and materials before buying.

A 16-by-16-inch multicolor throw pillow from Camping Designs by Jude with a campfire design and the words 'camping without beer is just sitting in the woods.' It has a double-sided print on 100 percent spun polyester and is sewn closed. The listing calls it a novelty gift for campers.

A six-pair pack of adidas men's no-show socks in black and onix marl, in large for shoe sizes 6 to 12. They have a lightweight Superlite construction, a large adidas wordmark knit on the outside of the foot, and moisture-wicking yarn to keep feet dry.

Black ballet flats for women in size 7, with a soft faux suede exterior and an elastic ankle strap. They have a contoured, thick cushioned sole and a heel zipper for easy on and off. The listing describes them as comfortable slip-on walking and work shoes.

A 24-by-24-inch framed canvas print of gray and yellow blossom flowers from LevvArts, with a giclee finish on waterproof canvas. Each panel comes with a hook already mounted on a wooden bar, ready to hang. The back is covered with flannel to hide staples or tacks.

A full-figure ivory underwire bra from Wacoal's Retro Chic line, sized 34G. It features lace construction with two-part seamed full-coverage cups, a sheer mesh window at the top of the cups, and a leotard back. The band and sides are designed to smooth and minimize bulge.

Hybrid silk mink eyelash extensions from Yelix in mixed lengths from 8 to 15 millimeters and thicknesses of 0.07 or 0.10 millimeters. Several L-series curls are available, including L, L+, LC, LD, and LU. The listing describes the lashes as black, soft, and free of residue and kinks.

A natural-colored indoor and outdoor cuddle and play lounge from Lulyboo that transforms into a backpack in one motion. It weighs less than four pounds and includes a removable activity bar and canopy. The base is waterproof, the cover is machine washable, and it is safety tested.

A yellow shockproof case for iPod touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation models. It has a hard plastic outer shell with a soft silicone inner skin and a raised bezel to protect the screen and camera. It is slim and lightweight, and it does not fit the iPod touch 4.

A refillable frosted plastic soap dispenser pump from mDesign with a 12-ounce capacity, designed for hand soap, dish soap, or sanitizer. Its round, compact body fits on most bathroom sinks and countertops, and the removable pump head makes refilling easy. It comes in black with a brushed finish.

specs.coverage: up to 500 sq ft per kit

record.description: A black polycuramine garage floor coating kit from Rust-Oleum's Rocksolid line, covering up to 500 square feet depending on surface porosity. The self-leveling formula is walk-on ready in 8 to 10 hours. It creates a high-gloss, terrazzo-look finish that resists chemical spills and hot tire pickup.

A silver wireless Magic Trackpad 2 from Apple with a rechargeable built-in battery and Force Touch sensing. Four force sensors beneath the glass let you click anywhere and detect different pressure levels. The edge-to-edge glass surface is nearly 30 percent larger than the previous trackpad, and it pairs automatically with a Mac.

A pack of 68 natural vetiver incense sticks from Bodhi Spirit, 11 inches long and totaling 200 grams. The light scent is intended for worship, aromatherapy, meditation, and yoga, and lasts up to 24 hours in a room. The sticks are made from 100 percent natural herbs with low smoke.

A women's unlined dotted mesh bralette from Savage X Fenty in black caviar, size large. Stretch lace trims the cups, underarms, and underband, and double rouleau adjustable elastic straps offer fit control. The rose gold tone hardware completes the look.

A red pizza oven from Kalorik with a removable stone for crisp, even baking of frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough pizzas. It has upper and lower heating elements, a preheating function, and variable temperature control up to about 680 degrees Fahrenheit.

A women's black 3-in-1 winter ski jacket from Wantdo in medium, which can be worn as a waterproof shell, an insulated liner, or both together. The shell is made of poly pongee and has a detachable adjustable hood, elastic cuffs, and a YKK zipper. It is windproof.

A one-size deluxe Halloween headdress from amscan with large black, white, and blue faux feathers and white marabou trim on the sides. It fits most teens and adults and is suited to role play, costume parties, and events. The listing describes it as a complement to a Native American costume.

A pre-owned women's Rolex Lady Datejust 179178 automatic watch with a white dial and 18-karat yellow gold bracelet and bezel. The listing describes it as excellent and certified authentic. It comes with a one-year warranty and a final quality control check before shipment.

A six-pair set of women's crew socks from Kikiya in assorted rainbow and solid colors. The socks are made in Korea and suit both athletic and fashion wear. The brand says it has been making hosiery since 2004 and offers a full refund if the socks do not meet expectations.

specs.type: matte lip crayon with lip balm

record.description: A matte lip crayon with a built-in lip balm, sold as a 2-in-1 lip kit. The buildable, weightless formula glides on with a soft feel and is listed as non-bleeding and non-feathering. The pointed tip helps line lips, and the balm can add shine on top of lipstick.

A 9-foot beige half patio and table umbrella from FLAME&SHADE with a tilting push button and crank lift. It has steel ribs and a heavy-duty aluminum frame, with a 200gsm water-resistant solution-dyed polyester fabric and a large top vent for airflow. The base stand and storage cover are sold separately.

A four-pack of 11.5-ounce mulled cider scented candles from Mainstays in glass jars with three wicks each. The candles are described as highly fragrant and easy to light, and they should be stored in a cool place. They add a warm fragrance to home décor.

A soft nude mid-thigh shaping short from SPANX's Thinstincts 1.0 line, available in regular and plus sizes. Its engineered panel provides tummy control, and the microfiber fabric is lightweight and breathable. The cotton gusset helps prevent visible panty lines, and it is elastic-free to avoid pinching.

A four-pack of girls' racerback crop cami bralettes from Reebok in all white, size 6 to 7. They have removable pads, a seamless tag-free design, and no-show straps. The listing describes them as stretchy and lightweight, and recommends machine washing cool and tumble drying low.

A women's 6-inch waterproof work boot from Timberland PRO in Turkish coffee, with a premium full-grain leather upper and waterproof membrane. It has an alloy safety toe, an all-weather TPU outsole, and a Dynamic Anti-Fatigue Technology footbed. It is built on a women's last for fit and comfort.

A black 10x25 compact binocular from Leica's Ultravid BR line, with a rubber-armored housing and central focusing knob. Its multicoated and AquaDura-coated outer lenses resist water, dirt, and scratches. The housing is listed as water-resistant to a depth of 16.5 feet (5 meters), and the optics offer strong stray-light suppression.

A black slim shell keyboard case from Fintie for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 10.5-inch 2018 tablet, with a detachable Bluetooth keyboard. The keyboard has a seven-color backlight, and the adjustable stand holds the tablet in landscape mode. The PU leather cover has an anti-slip rubber-lined interior.

A pack of about 100 colorful jumbo plastic straws, 0.43 inches in diameter and 8.2 inches long, with wide openings for smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. Eight random colors are mixed, and the straws have no sharp corners. They can be used once or washed and reused, and can serve as craft material.

A purple women's lace-up rock climbing and bouldering shoe from Climb X, the Crush Lace NLV model from 2020. It has a leather upper that offers stretch and breathability, a smooth last for long wear, and front edge protection. Its lacing allows adjustment for a snug fit.

A box of 25 green letter-size laminated two-pocket folders from Oxford, each with an interior die-cut business card holder. The high-gloss finish looks polished for client leave-behinds or school presentations. The laminated material is more tear-resistant than standard paper, and each pocket holds up to 50 sheets.

Gray convertible mittens from Palmyth in large that flip open with magnets to become fingerless gloves. They are insulated with 40 grams of 3M Thinsulate and fleece, with a 4-way stretch shell and an insert windproof TPU membrane. The design suits fishing, photography, running, and other outdoor activities in cold weather.

Men's black slim-fit flat-front dress pants from Amazon Essentials in size 28 waist by 28 length. They are fitted through the hip and thigh with a tapered leg and sit below the waist. The silky twill polyester fabric moves easily, and the rear has two button-through welt pockets.

A women's off-white hooded jacket from Save The Duck with a faux sheepskin lining and a fixed hood lined in echo-lamb. Made of 100 percent nylon, it is described as light and soft, and it protects against wind and rain. It has a double zipper and invisible-zip pockets.

A six-pair pack of baby crew socks from Fruit of the Loom in 6 to 12 months, with three cooling mesh pairs and three thermal waffle pairs in blue. The cushioned soles and non-skid grippers help minimize slipping. The socks are machine washable and can be tumble dried.

A 1.5-inch hot red sheer organza wired ribbon from VATIN, sold as 25 yards. The ribbon is described as waterproof and holds shape for making bows and wreaths. It suits outdoor holiday decorations and floral arrangements, with a subtle sheen and neatly finished edges.

A 3-inch preformed lap joint exhaust band clamp made of 304 stainless steel that joins 3.0-inch outside diameter pipe to 3.0-inch inside diameter pipe. It has a 2.94-inch strap. The clamp distributes force evenly around 360 degrees to help seal connections and prevent leaks in exhaust systems.

A 9 by 12 foot drop cloth made of 10-ounce 100 percent cotton canvas with double-stitched seams to prevent fraying. It protects floors, carpets, and furniture indoors and outdoors and absorbs paint spills. The cloth can be washed for repeated use, and the listing describes it as seamless.

A pack of 30 disposable clear plastic stemmed martini glasses holding about 5 ounces each, designed for desserts, mousse, appetizers, and cocktails. The glass-like finish is meant to present food with style. Each package contains cups and bases, and the cups suit weddings and birthday parties.

A case of 24 white athletic field marking paint cans from Ameri-Stripe, with 18-ounce cans that fit most competitors' aerosol machines. The universal tip works with nearly all marking machines. It is formulated for line striping athletic fields and dries quickly with single-coat coverage.

Rectangular full-rim plastic sunglasses from Gucci in dark havana with gold accents, model GG0381S 008 and a 57 millimeter lens width. The lenses are green silver mirror, non-polarized, and offer 100 percent UV protection. The listing gives an 18-millimeter bridge and a 145-millimeter arm length.

A 0.17-ounce splash of Versace Eros Pour Femme eau de parfum for women, a small sample size. The listing repeats the product name and size and gives few other details, so check the fragrance notes before ordering.

A women's black long down hooded winter jacket from Columbia's McKay Lake line, in medium. It is lightweight with heatseal warmth, 650-fill down insulation, and water-resistant fabric. The jacket has secure hand pockets and a dual zipper.
