A foldable mini drone from Baoer, model LF606, in a standard version that does not include a camera. It has a 4-channel design for ascend, descend, and directional flight, plus altitude hold and GPS return-to-home. The drone's arms are replaceable if they break, so the drone can fly again.

Three pairs of reusable black silicone ear plugs from Eargrace in small, medium, and large sizes. The oval shape is designed to fit the ear canal and block noise, and the ear hooks help keep them in place during sleep. The listing rates noise reduction at SNR 31 dB.

A women's juniors high-rise A-line long maxi denim skirt in light blue, size XL, from Fashion2Love. The listing says the denim is comfortable and durable and suits work, school, or social occasions across seasons. Check the sizing chart in the product photos before ordering.

Women's mid-rise 7/8-length active leggings from Amazon Essentials in black and blue, size large. They have a side stripe, a flat wide waistband, and flatlock stitching for comfort and mobility. The inseam measures 25 inches and the front rise measures 10 inches.

An 18 by 10.5 inch embossed tin sign from Harley-Davidson, item 2011591, featuring a die-cut and embossed Bar and Shield logo with Harley-Davidson script. It has holes for hanging and is described as a gift for Harley enthusiasts. The listing suggests it for a garage, shop, or other room.

A four-pack of oversized square ladies' reading glasses from Eyekepper with spring hinges and a frame height of about 47 millimeters. Each pair comes in one power, and the listing notes that the pairs are not mixed powers. The glasses carry a full refund if the customer is not satisfied.

specs.features: open slots for audio jack, charger, buttons

record.description: A smoke-colored skeleton-design soft silicone case for the iPhone 7 Plus and iPhone 8 Plus. It is ultra thin and slim, with openings for the audio jack, charger cable, and volume buttons. The case is listed as easily removable and lightweight, and it protects against scratches.

A pack of eight DMC cotton embroidery floss skeins in holiday colors, with an over-dyed effect. Each six-strand skein measures 8.7 yards. The thread is 100 percent cotton, and the listing gives model number 417XUS63.

An 85-inch Samsung QLED 4K UHD smart TV, model QN85Q60AAFXZA from the Q60A series, with Quantum Dot color and Quantum HDR. It has dual LED backlights that adjust in real time, a slim design, and a Quantum Processor for 4K upscaling. Alexa is built in, and it is a 2021 model.

A pair of 18K white gold promise rings from Aooaz with inlaid round stones totaling 0.04 carats, sized 6.5 for women and 10.5 for men. The listing describes a minimalist design for anniversaries and other occasions. Keep it in its box and away from water, sweat, and perfume.

A men's long-sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia's PFG line with a tribal-inspired fish graphic and a classic fit. The Omni-Shade fabric is designed to block UVA and UVB rays with a tight weave and UV-absorbent yarns. Omni-Wick technology moves moisture to the surface to evaporate, keeping the wearer cool and dry.

A five-pack of Gildan men's A-shirt undershirts in grey and black in X-large. The solids are 100 percent cotton, and the sport grey shirts blend in 10 percent polyester. The tag-free shirts are described as soft, moisture-wicking, and double-needle hemmed. Colors may vary.

A men's Timex IQ+ Move smartwatch with a white dial, green hour markers, and a black leather strap. Its silver-tone 43-millimeter brass case has an Indiglo light. It tracks steps, distance, calories, and sleep, and syncs with a phone over Bluetooth. The watch is water resistant to 50 meters for recreational swimming.

Kids' black and white running shoe from New Balance in size 3.5 women's US Big Kid, for ages 8 to 12. It has a BOA fit system, a breathable synthetic and mesh upper, and a lightweight REVlite midsole. A rubber outsole provides traction, and the laceless design makes it easy to wear.

An adjustable blade clipper from Andis, model 69100, with a black and chrome alloy housing. Its patent-pending XTR technology is designed to reduce temperature and noise, and the listing says it runs cooler and quieter than the Envy Clipper. The carbon steel blade adjusts from 000 to 1 and can be zero-gapped.

A black ankle-length hooded bathrobe from Arus in X-large, made of 100 percent Turkish cotton with single-ply loops inside and out. The listing says it gets softer with each wash. It has a wide hood and patch pockets, and it can be worn after a sauna, gym, pool, or at the beach.

A red gaming chair from Scurrty with an ergonomic design, a sturdy metal frame, and an adjustable seat for different heights. It rotates 360 degrees, offers a rocking function, and has a detachable headrest and a footrest. The listing describes it as suitable for long gaming or office sessions.

A royal blue sequined tulle ball gown from Glitz with a sweetheart neckline, sleeveless bodice, and 3D floral details. It has pearls and beading, a floor-length princess skirt, and a corset back. The listing describes it as made to order for quinceañera, prom, and formal events, and requires measurements for the right fit.

A youth short-sleeve creamsicle orange T-shirt from Smack Apparel with a Tampa Bay football fan design. It is made of 100 percent cotton, screen printed in the USA, and pre-shrunk. The listing describes it as machine washable and notes that the design is copyrighted by Smack Apparel.

A laser presentation remote from Logitech, model R500, with USB or Bluetooth connectivity and a range of about 20 meters. It works with Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, and common presentation software, and it can be customized through the Logitech app. The listing notes it is discontinued by the manufacturer.

A chrome tub spout from Delta, model RP4370, designed for pull-out diverter hand shower use. It is made to original specifications and is listed as tested for quality performance. It fits standard 1/2-inch or 3/4-inch pipe and is intended for Delta faucets.

A two-piece silver stainless steel gift set from Zebra, with a 0.7-millimeter HB mechanical pencil and a 0.8-millimeter black ballpoint pen. It has a knurled grip for steady writing and a soft, silent retraction plunger. The listing describes the ink as easy-glide and smooth.

A white quilted king-size heated mattress pad from Sunbeam with dual side controllers, each offering 10 heat settings. Its controllers include auto-off and consistent heat. It is made of 100 percent polyester, machine washable and dryer safe, with a 5-year limited warranty.

A black trunk-mounted carrier from Allen Sports, model 103DN-R, that holds three bikes. It has individual tie-downs, a padded lower frame to protect the vehicle, and side straps. It folds flat for storage. The listing says it fits most sedans, hatchbacks, minivans, and SUVs, and suggests checking the manufacturer's site for vehicle fit.

A burgundy off-the-shoulder maxi dress in size US 12 with layered ruffles, an empire waist, and a thigh-high side slit. The ruched waist and elastic back are designed for comfortable all-day wear. The listing says it can be worn four ways, including strapless or one-shoulder.

A men's engraved wooden quartz watch from BOBO BIRD that combines wood and stainless steel, with a Japanese quartz movement. The listing describes it as lightweight and comfortable, and it comes in a bamboo watch box. It suits both casual and business occasions.

A 14-inch cream-dial wall clock from Bulova, inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright's Luxfer Prism design. It features raised hour markers and shadowed graphics, encased in individual bronze rods, and is driven by a quartz crystal. The listing describes it as a modern accent for any room.

A silver unlocked LG K31 smartphone with 32 GB of storage and a 5.7-inch HD+ display. It has a 13-megapixel main rear camera, a 5-megapixel super wide camera, and a 5-megapixel front camera with portrait mode. The 3,000 mAh battery is listed as long lasting, and the phone is compatible with several US carriers.

A double-sided 5.8-inch glass makeup mirror from Gotofine with 1X regular magnification on one side and 10X on the other. It rotates 360 degrees and can be fixed at any angle, and its lightweight design works as a tabletop or handheld mirror. The listing calls it clear and transparent.

specs.contents: storage tote, pen set, blade, tools

record.description: An accessory bundle for the Cricut Joy machine with a padded storage tote that has custom pockets. It includes a starter tool kit with a weeder, spatula, and scraper, a fine-point pen set, and a replacement blade. The listing says the blade is designed to resist wear and breakage for crisp, clean cuts.

A dainty 14K gold plated evil eye pendant necklace from MEVECCO with a hammered finish and cubic zirconia accent. The chain is 16.5 inches with a 2-inch extension and is made of brass that the listing says is lead and nickel free. It comes in a gift box and suits parties, weddings, and graduations.

A pink Himalayan salt lamp with a wooden base, an integrated dimmer switch, and an extra bulb. It casts a warm orange glow that can be adjusted for day or night. The listing describes the salt as hand carved, and each lamp has a unique shape. Check size details before ordering.

A white 6-cup stovetop espresso maker, or moka pot, from GROSCHE with a 9.3-ounce capacity. Made of food-grade anodized aluminum, it brews rich coffee on gas, electric, and propane camping stoves. The listing says it is easier to use than electric espresso machines, and 3-, 6-, and 9-cup sizes are available.

A men's white adidas Originals X_PLR sneaker in size 9 with a knit upper and mesh lining. It has webbing tape three-stripe details, a nubuck heel, and an OrthoLite sockliner for comfort. A speed lacing system provides quick adjustment.

A two-pair set of unisex stainless steel magnetic stud earrings with square cubic zirconia stones, in 5-millimeter black and white. Their magnetic backs mean no piercing is needed, and the listing says they are allergy-free and suitable for sensitive ears. They work for men and women alike.

Women's plus-size white soft knit Bermuda shorts from Roamans in size 3X, with a 12-inch inseam and a pull-on elastic waist. The cotton and polyester blend has a relaxed fit for everyday wear and is machine washable. The listing says size 3X fits plus sizes 30 to 32.

A 10-inch pink silicone-coated whisk from GorGin with a stainless steel handle that has a hanging hole. The food-grade coating is designed not to scratch pots and pans, and the listing describes it as heat resistant and easy to clean. It works for blending, whisking, beating, and stirring.

A rose red tri-fold synthetic leather wallet from UTO with a cute cat and bowknot charm, a snap closure, and a kiss lock coin pocket. It has 13 card slots including 2 clear photo slots, plus a bill section. It measures about 4.2 by 3.2 by 1.4 inches.

A grey tufted storage bench from AC Pacific with a hardwood frame and bonded-leather upholstery. It measures 17 by 38 by 16 inches and offers both storage and a padded top for extra seating or a footrest. Crystal-like accents add a touch of sparkle to a traditional bedroom or entry.

A set of 60 permanent adhesive vinyl sheets from Ohuhu, each 12 by 12 inches, in 30 shades for crafts, decals, and party decorations. The set includes 10 clear transfer tape sheets, which the listing says hold vinyl in place and release without bubbles or tearing.

A renewed OtterBox Symmetry Series case for iPhone X only, in the On Fleck pattern. Its ultra-slim profile has a dual-material construction that absorbs shock, along with a raised beveled edge that protects the touchscreen. The wraparound colors and graphics are designed to add style. The listing describes installation as quick and easy.

A women's navy full-zip fleece jacket from Columbia's Benton Springs line in X-small. It is made of soft 100 percent polyester MTR filament fleece with a collared neck, two side zippered pockets, and a classic, lightweight active fit. The listing describes it as an essential for cold-weather days.

An adult sonic electric toothbrush from Sporzin with five modes and three intensity levels. The listing describes an 8-millimeter swing amplitude that lets the brush head clean along the gaps between teeth, and a smart timer. A toothbrush holder is included.

Six bunches of Giant Hairgrass aquarium plants from Greenpro, a species that forms dense background cover in freshwater tanks. The roots take nutrients from the substrate as a root feeder, and the plants produce oxygen. Each bunch is inspected and packed in boxes suited to all weather conditions.

A cream micro-fleece wearable blanket from HALO, sized 2/3T for big kids, with a dog print and a TOG rating of 1.0. The generous sack design allows room to kick while staying on through the night, and the foot openings let children move when awake. It is worn over regular sleepwear.

A men's dark Star Trek: The Next Generation pajama set from CafePress with a crewneck shirt in breathable 100 percent cotton. The relaxed-fit bottoms have a no-fly waist, and the plaid bottoms are cotton flannel with side pockets. The listing says the design is professionally printed.

Men's Timberland traditional handsewn 3-eyelet classic lug boot in burgundy and brown, size 12 M. It has premium leather uppers stitched to the midsole and cemented to the outsole, with 360-degree rawhide lacing for a custom fit. It has a leather lining and a rubber lug outsole.

specs.features: deep button tufting, nail head accents

record.description: A navy blue and dark brown Chesterfield loveseat from Christopher Knight Home with deep button tufting and hand-applied nail head accents on the scrolled arms. It measures 61.75 by 33.75 by 27.75 inches, with a seat 45 inches wide. The tufting is said to add breathing space and limit heat while you relax.

An adjustable sliding window vent kit from Gulrear for portable air conditioners with 5.9-inch exhaust hoses. Its plates extend from 20 to 55 inches, and you can use fewer plates if the window is shorter. It works for vertical and horizontal sliding windows and is presented as an alternative to the factory kit.

A unisex maroon crewneck sweatshirt from NuffSaid with a white-ink Hawkins Middle School AV Club screen-printed design. It is printed in the USA from a 50/50 blend that is soft and comfortable. The listing notes the fit typically runs large for women and makes a great gift.

A white 3.5-gallon underwater viewing bucket from Battlewagon with a 9-inch viewing lens, designed for boats, kayaks, docks, and beaches. Its rope handle is 5/8-inch marine-grade nylon, and the bucket can be filled to the top. It is used for viewing sea life, reefs, anchors, and traps, and for carrying bait or catch.

A cordless, rechargeable lithium-ion pool vacuum from Pool Blaster with a larger debris capacity than the standard Catfish. It has a removable 10.5-inch vacuum head for general cleaning, and a nose cone head for hard-to-reach spots. It is designed for in-ground, soft-sided, and above-ground pools, and the listing describes it as hoseless.

A black full-frame DSLR from Canon, the EOS-1D X Mark III, with a 20.1-megapixel CMOS sensor and DIGIC X processor. It has a 191-point autofocus system with subject tracking, and high-speed continuous shooting of up to 16 frames per second. The bundle includes a CFexpress card and reader, and the camera records 4K video.

A rustic wooden HOME tile wall sign from Barnyard Designs measuring 32 by 8 inches, with white letters on an unfinished wood finish. It arrives with pre-installed hanging hooks and strings for easy mounting. The sign suits country, primitive, and farmhouse decor and works as a housewarming gift.

A black low-profile fixed wall mount from Sanus that holds 37- to 80-inch flat or curved TVs and monitors up to 130 pounds. It places the screen just 1.84 inches from the wall, and it has a quick-release locking mechanism. Post-install horizontal shift helps center the TV between studs up to 24 inches apart.

A white heavy-duty tension curtain rod from ALLZONE that extends from 83 to 120 inches. It has a lock-in feature to prevent slipping and heavy-duty internal springs designed to hold blackout curtains. It works on surfaces such as wallpaper, tile, glass, and wood, and can serve as a room divider or shower rod.

A 72-inch black lockable steel storage cabinet from AOBABO with four detachable rubber casters, two of which lock. It has a corner protector for security and is designed to move on hardwood, laminate, tile, and carpet without scratching. It requires assembly with tools, and the parts are included and marked.

A grey long-sleeve newborn romper from Goodstoworld for 0 to 3 months, made of soft, stretchy cotton blend. It has an expandable neckline for easy dressing and snap closures for diaper changes. The printed message is part of the design, and the romper is presented as a baby shower gift.

A large hardcover Moleskine limited-edition notebook in the Sakura design, measuring 5 by 8.25 inches with 240 ruled pages. It has a leather-like cover, an elastic closure band, and inner storage folders. The thick ivory paper is described as suited to fountain pens.

Navy mesh first-walker sneakers for babies in the 12 to 18 month size. The breathable upper has a stretchy knit collar for slip-on wear, and rubber soft spikes on the sole help prevent slipping. A toe cap adds protection, and memory foam footbeds provide cushioning for all-day play.

A 4.23-ounce violet temporary hair color wax from Permotary that can be molded, sculpted, and textured. The listing says it is made with natural ingredients, washes out easily, and is not sticky. It comes in nine colors for parties and cosplay, and works best on slightly damp hair.

A baby blue UV LED nail lamp rated at 120 watts with 36 lamp beads and an automatic sensor that turns it on and off with your hands. It has timer settings of 15, 30, 60, and 99 seconds, plus a low-power mode. The listing says it cures gel polish faster than many 72-watt lamps.

A 7-speed electric hand mixer from Cqfly with a turbo function that speeds up each setting. It includes four chrome-plated attachments, two dough hooks, and two beaters, plus a compact storage base that keeps everything together. The slim unit is designed to fit into tight spaces and is suited to whipping, mixing, and baking.

A full-motion TV wall mount from Mount-It! for 19- to 40-inch TVs and computer monitors, supporting up to 33 pounds. It tilts, rotates, and swivels, with a 14-inch extension arm, and is compatible with VESA 75 and 100 patterns. The listing says it allows portrait or landscape orientation and helps with ergonomic viewing.

A four-skein lot of Alize Diva silk-effect knitting yarn in cream, made of 100 percent microfiber acrylic. Each 100-gram skein measures about 383 yards and is fingering weight. The listing says the yarn has a silk sheen, is soft and lightweight, does not fade in sun, and suits spring and summer clothing.

A watercolor cowboy-themed pillow cover from HGOD DESIGNS, 18 by 18 inches, made of cotton linen-look fabric. The design is printed on both sides and closes with a hidden zipper on one side. It is machine washable on cold, gentle cycle.

A reversible purple and turquoise sherpa throw from Lush Decor's Brookdale line, measuring 60 by 50 inches. It features a colorful floral and geometric patchwork pattern in a cottage or bohemian style. The soft 100 percent polyester throw is machine washable in cold water and can be tumble dried on low.

A cool white rechargeable touch closet light with eight SMD LEDs and up to 120 lumens of brightness. Its 1230 mAh built-in battery runs about 5 hours at the brightest setting, and it recharges by micro-USB cable. A touch sensor turns it on, dims, or off, and the light bar rotates for angle adjustment.

A pack of two golden yellow striped velvet throw pillow covers from DEZENE, each 20 by 20 inches, made of soft poly velvet with an invisible zipper. The covers suit sofas, beds, chairs, and farmhouse decor, and inserts must be bought separately. They are machine washable.

A pack of 20 individually wrapped essential oil hand towelettes from Herban Essentials, sized for travel. The wipes are presented as a natural alternative to alcohol-based cleansers that keeps hands clean without drying out skin. The listing describes aromatherapy benefits such as relaxation and better mood.

A red spruce wreath for the front door from OasisCraft with pine cones and 50 battery-operated LED lights. The lights run on three AA batteries, which are not included, and include a timer set for 6 hours on and 18 hours off. It suits Christmas and other festivals.

A reversible printed tree base collar from The Christmas Tree Hugger that conceals the pole of an artificial Christmas tree, with bark on one side and candy on the other. It is 8.5 by 8.5 inches flat and fits poles up to 6.5 inches around. The flexible material can be folded or cut to fit.

A small round black PU leather crossbody bag with a snakeskin-print front pocket and gold-tone hardware. It measures about 7.4 by 7.4 by 2.3 inches and weighs 0.59 pounds, and can be carried as a shoulder or crossbody bag. It has a top zipper, a main compartment, and an inside zip pocket.

A metallic red 4-slice toaster from Cuisinart's Metal Classic line with brushed stainless steel housing and dual control panels. It has six browning settings, dual reheat, defrost, and bagel buttons with LED indicators, plus 1.5-inch-wide slots and a slide-out crumb tray. The toaster carries a 3-year limited warranty.

A black front driver-side window regulator from Dorman, part number 749-260, for select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu models. It is engineered and tested to match the fit and function of the original and was cycled many times to test durability. The listing says it is engineered in the USA. Check fit by entering your vehicle details.

Odorless garlic extract softgels from NutraChamps at 1000 milligrams per serving, enhanced with parsley, chlorophyll, and aged black garlic extract. The listing positions them as an immune support supplement and says they offer garlic's benefits without breath odor. The seller also lists heart, blood-pressure, and cholesterol support claims that are unverified here.

A red-lacquered E-flat student alto saxophone from Roy Benson, model RBAS202R, with a brass body and brass-lacquered keys. It includes a high F-sharp key, a C-sharp to B-flat connected table key, and a hardened blue steel spring. The package includes a rectangular case with backpack straps, a mouthpiece with ligature and cap, and a cleaning cloth.

A women's surplice wrap dress from JOA in an ivory and black abstract floral print. It has short flutter sleeves and is offered in size small. The listing gives few other details about fabric or length, so check the size chart and material before ordering.

A jumbo pack of 500 glossy black, unwrapped disposable plastic straws from Crystalware, each about 7.75 inches long. They are made of food-grade BPA-free polypropylene and come in a dispenser box. The straws suit bars, concession stands, schools, and home or party use, and are best for regular beverages.

A two-pack of nylon mesh replacement filter bags from PGFUN for Polaris 360 and 380 pool cleaners. The bags have a zipper for easy emptying and clips for simple installation and removal. The listing notes they are not suitable for the Polaris 280 or 480 models.

A 10-piece Pride Lands deluxe articulated figure set from Just Play based on Disney Junior's The Lion Guard. Each figure stands about 3 inches tall in a dynamic action pose. The set includes Kion, Fuli, Bunga, Ono, Beshte, Simba, Nala, Rafiki, Timon, and Pumbaa, and is suited to both play and display.

A short-sleeve graphic T-shirt with a sarcastic family-joke text design, offered as a gag gift for moms, daughters, aunts, uncles, and grandmas. It is lightweight with a classic fit and double-needle sleeve and bottom hems. The listing gives few other details about the fabric or the exact design text.

A 1-quart hydroponic plant supplement from General Hydroponics, the BioBud model GH5332, that provides minerals and amino acids to flowering plants. The listing says it encourages abundant flowering and fruit production and works alongside BioThrive bloom fertilizer as a bloom enhancer.

A beaded sand dollar napkin box from Mariposa made of recycled sandcast aluminum. It was designed by Michael Updike and is not dishwasher safe. The listing gives few other details about its size or finish.

A black genuine leather badge holder with a zipper and RFID keychain wallet, with a 20-inch detachable polyester lanyard and swivel hook. It measures 4.6 by 3.1 by 0.12 inches and has a clear front ID window, four card slots, a zipper coin pocket, and a cash section. It is slim.

A four-pack of white extra-large bath towels from YIH measuring 31 by 63 inches, made of 100 percent ring-spun cotton at 800 GSM. The listing describes them as fade-resistant, super absorbent, and soft and fluffy. They are machine washable and can be tumble dried on low, and washing them separately on first use reduces lint.

A soft TPU protective phone case for iPhone 5, 6, 7, 8, and X with a Bangtan Boys BTS design permanently dyed into the material, so it is not a sticker or vinyl. Openings are cut for the buttons and camera lens. The listing describes it as a must-have for fans.

A snug-fitting cotton footed sleeper from Amazon Essentials in a dot pattern, sized 18 months. It has a zip-up front for easy fastening and removal. The listing notes that the snug fit is intended for children's sleepwear safety.

specs.care: hand or machine wash, hang dry

record.description: A short-sleeve solid white T-shirt dress for girls from Arshiner, sized from 3T to 13 years. The listing describes it as soft and resistant to wrinkles and fading. It suits school, holidays, parties, beach trips, and everyday wear, and can be paired with leggings or coats.

A classroom master pack of 36 Prang watercolor sets, made up of 12 each of 8-color basic, glitter, and metallic sets. Each set comes with a brush, and the box has an easy-open lid. The washable paints offer 24 colors in total and are AP certified non-toxic, easily washing off skin and most clothing.

A lightweight, classic-fit vintage graphic T-shirt with the text 'I Can't Make Everyone Happy, I'm Not a Taco.' It has a double-needle sleeve and bottom hem. The listing offers few other details about the fabric, color, or sizing.

A four-piece set of 2-in-1 capacitive styluses from Bargains Depot in black, blue, purple, and red, each 5.5 inches long. They have stainless steel and aluminum bodies with 4.5-millimeter and 6-millimeter rubber tips, and the set includes 20 replacement tips. The listing says they work with iPad, iPhone, Kindle, and tablets.

A slip-on canvas loafer-style shoe from Stylein for toddlers and little kids, with a leopard print upper and white rubber sole. The elastic tongue makes it easy to put on and take off, and the anti-collision toe cap adds protection. The soft canvas is comfortable for running and playing.

A pack of 100 clear 5-millimeter infrared emitter LEDs from Chanzon with an 850-nanometer wavelength and a 60-degree emitting angle. They run on 1.4 to 1.6 volts at 20 milliamps and are through-hole DIP parts with a longer anode leg. The listing suggests them for IR beam sensors, remotes, and Arduino or Raspberry Pi projects.

A pink 2-in-1 transforming pullover hoodie and soft plushie called Kali the Kitty from Cubcoats. The listing describes it as fully lined, made with non-allergenic materials, with animal ears on the hood and a soft-tipped zipper pull. It is presented as easy to care for and safe for young children.

A black porcelain drip pan replacement set of four, with two 8-inch and two 6-inch pans, designed to fit GE, Hotpoint, and Kenmore ranges and cooktops. The pans catch drippings and food that fall from the oven element and have a locking slot. The listing lists the replaced part numbers for each size.

A four-pack of Hanes men's short-sleeve T-shirts in light steel in X-large, with a full cut for a roomier fit. The listing says the shirts are 100 percent cotton in ash, while light steel is 90 percent cotton and 10 percent polyester. Double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem adds durability.
A 16-ounce package of Bob's Red Mill arrowroot starch, which can also be used as flour. The listing gives few details beyond calling it the highest quality.

A women's plus-size sleeveless floral romper from Romwe in multicolor, sized 4XL. It has a V-neck, spaghetti straps, and a short jumpsuit cut in lightweight fabric with some stretch. The listing suggests it for vacations, beach parties, and casual outings, and gives a detailed size chart.

Two 63-inch bird perches from Lee-buty made of coated stainless steel wire wrapped in cotton rope. They are flexible enough to bend into any shape and have a hook at the top for attaching to a cage. The listing says the edible colorful ropes are non-toxic and suited to parrots, parakeets, and cockatiels.

A roll of 20 extra-thick black PE trash bags from SADUORHAPPY with double-seam construction. The listing describes them as tear and leak resistant and says they fit most household and office trash cans. The bags are made of PE material with no smell and are described as biodegradable.

A rectangular brushed stainless steel touch-bar recycling bin from simplehuman, model CW2018, with 48 liters of capacity split into two 24-liter buckets. The touch bar opens the lid from any angle, and the stay-open lid and dampers keep it moving smoothly and evenly. The finish is fingerprint-proof.

A black entry-level Blu-ray disc player from Panasonic, model DMP-BD45, with full 1080p playback and up-conversion of 480i/p and 720p to 1080p. It boots in about 0.5 seconds, has an SDXC and USB slot for JPEG photos and AVCHD video, and uses VieraLink for control with one remote. It is more compact and energy efficient.

Men's black bearing slipper from Deer Stags in size 12 M US, with a buttery faux shearling lining and stretchy elastic goring for a secure fit. It is designed to be worn indoors and outdoors, with a heel cushion and compression nodules on the outsole for support. The brand has made shoes since 1929.

A collapsible PopSockets grip and stand in the Stony Heart design for phones and tablets. It offers a secure grip for one-handed texting and steadier photos, and folds into a stand for watching videos. The listing says it sticks to smooth and hard cases but not silicone or highly textured ones.

A three-pack of white diaper covers from Hanes Ultimate Baby Flexy in 0 to 6 months. The 4-way stretch fabric is soft and flexible, moving with the baby for a snug fit. Reinforced snaps are designed for durability, and sizes come in 6-month steps.

A men's white crew-neck T-shirt from Bravado in XX-large, featuring a distressed Union Jack design with a Rolling Stones graphic on the front. The shirt is officially licensed merchandise. The listing gives few other details about the fabric or fit.

A six-pair pack of women's ankle socks from Hanes in women's shoe sizes 5 to 9. They include arch support and targeted cushioning in the heel and toe without bulk. X-Temp technology is said to adapt to body temperature for all-day comfort.

A 74-inch fawn oversized loveseat from Stone & Beam with down-filled cushions and a solid hardwood frame. It has a contemporary silhouette with track arms in a stain-resistant performance fabric. The seat cushion is removable and reversible, and no assembly is required.

A white short-sleeve girls' summer sundress from Arshiner in size 8, with a swing hem for a playful look. The listing describes it as soft and comfortable, and the solid color is easy to pair with jackets or cardigans. Sizes are listed for girls aged 3 to 13 years.

An indoor spinning exercise bike from Joopee with a front and rear stabilizer and an adjustable saddle. The listing describes it as ultra-quiet and includes assembly instructions for the stabilizers, pedals, and saddle. The left pedal tightens counterclockwise, and the right pedal clockwise.

A men's white canvas slip-on sneaker from Lugz in size 10 D US, with a vulcanized rubber outsole and side gore panels that stretch for easy on and off. It has a cushioned insole, a breathable lining, and a padded collar for a comfortable fit.

A waterproof action camera kit from REMALI that records 4K UHD video and 12-megapixel photos with a 170-degree wide-angle lens. The kit includes three batteries, a dual battery charger, a carrying case, and 21 mounts and accessories, plus a 2-inch LCD screen, WiFi, and a remote control. The listing describes it as a lower-cost alternative to GoPro.

A 192-piece mechanics tool set from DEWALT, model DWMT75049, with polished chrome vanadium tools and hand-stamped markings. The listing highlights a knurled control ring and DirectTorque technology on the mechanics tools. The set is intended for mechanical work.

specs.features: molded toe cap, TPU heel clip

record.description: Midnight navy and white Under Armour Nitro Low MC football shoe in size 6.5. Its coated textile and synthetic upper form a support cage, with an open-holed mesh tongue for breathability. A molded toe cap, TPU heel clip, and die-cut EVA sockliner add protection, support, and comfort.

Sky blue women's socks from Socksmith with a beagle puppy print, sized 9 to 11 to fit women's shoe sizes 5 to 10.5. They are made of 63 percent cotton, 34 percent nylon, and 3 percent spandex. The listing describes them as playful and cute for everyday wear.

specs.features: two-sided printing, mobile print, scan, copy

record.description: A wireless all-in-one inkjet printer from HP, model 8QQ97A, for printing, scanning, and copying at home. It includes automatic two-sided printing, mobile printing, and a code for two years of Instant Ink delivery based on 100 pages per month. Setup uses the HP Smart app to connect to Wi-Fi and share with family devices.

A 12-inch Georgia Bulldogs team logo magnet from Fremont Die, printed on heavy-gauge magnetic vinyl in team colors. It attaches easily to metal surfaces such as cars, and the product is licensed under NCAA. The listing describes it as suited to outdoor lifestyle use.

A 0.5-fluid-ounce bottle of ZOYA nail polish in the Hunter shade. The listing gives little information beyond the product name and shade. Check a shade swatch before ordering if the exact color matters.

A black printed laptop backpack from Hurley for men with a 21-liter capacity and measurements of 45 by 30 by 24 centimeters. It has a main compartment with a laptop sleeve, a front pocket with an internal organizer, and a mesh side pocket for most water bottles. The bottom is water-resistant coated.

A little kid's running shoe from Nike's Revolution 4 line in wolf grey with racer pink accents, size 2.5Y. It has a hook-and-loop closure and laceless design for easy on and off. The upper is lightweight mesh with no-show overlays, and soft foam under the foot adds cushioning.

A chrome-plated brass 3-way T adapter from YUHX with a shut-off valve for connecting a bidet to a toilet filling valve. It has a ceramic valve and a leak-proof design, and it includes a screen filter washer. The listing says it can be connected by hand without tools and has a 7/8-inch cone washer.

An espresso-finish 55-inch computer desk from SHW Home Office with a powder-coated steel frame and environmental particle board top. The desktop has two grommets for cord management and adjustable glides to level it on uneven floors. It includes step-by-step instructions and hardware for assembly.

A stainless steel D System keg coupler from Kegco, model KC KTS97D-W, for American Sankey kegs. It has a clickable lever handle that engages the keg without pulling it out first, and a stainless steel probe. The listing describes the 304-grade steel body as commercial-grade and suited to pubs, bars, and restaurants.

A starry blue 6.5-inch self-balancing hoverboard from LIEAGLE with UL2272 certification, LED headlights, and RGB lights. It has a built-in wireless speaker that connects quickly to portable devices. The listing says it complies with US safety regulations and is designed to resist high temperatures and fire.

An orange authentic Mexican falsa blanket from Canyon Creek, measuring about 76 by 53 inches and weighing 3.5 pounds. It is made in Mexico from soft woven acrylic-treated cotton and is machine washable. It works as a yoga blanket or for curling up on the sofa, and dye lots may vary slightly in color.

specs.contents: two 8 oz glasses, two coasters, six stones

record.description: A New Orleans Saints whiskey gift set from Picnic Time in a solid oak box. It includes two 8-ounce heavy-bottom lowball glasses, two sandstone coasters, and six soapstone whiskey stones that help prevent drinks from watering down. The box is designed to hold all contents securely.

A navy blue vintage American flag T-shirt from Shop4Ever in medium, designed and printed in the United States. It has a comfortable modern fit in a cotton blend and is recommended for washing inside out in cold water. The print may appear smaller on larger sizes.

A handheld rechargeable misting fan from OPOLAR with a 2500 mAh battery, three speeds, and a 180-degree foldable design. It has a mist mode that cools quickly, a neon light, and quiet airflow suited to desk or backpack use. The listing describes it as portable for travel and outdoor use.

A single-DIN car stereo from Aigoss with Bluetooth, FM radio, and USB, TF, SD, and AUX inputs. It supports hands-free calling and wireless music control, and its illumination changes through five LED colors. The FM tuner covers 87.5 to 108 MHz with automatic and manual search, and a remote control is included.

A foldable USB-C to HDMI adapter from nonda that supports 4K video at up to 60 hertz. Its double-braided nylon cable is designed to resist spills, and the low-temperature injection-molded housing is intended to keep it from running hot. It fits in a laptop sleeve and works with MacBook, iPad Pro, Samsung, and Chromebook devices.

A 250-foot kraft single-face A-flute corrugated cardboard roll from Aviditi, 6 inches wide, used as a flexible wrap to protect glass, metal, and fragile items. Its raised flutes provide cushioning and crush resistance. It is made in the USA from recyclable material.

A 20-inch self-propelled gas lawn mower from PowerSmart with a 170cc four-stroke engine and a 20-inch steel mowing deck. Its three-wheel design with one universal front wheel makes it easy to change direction. It offers eight adjustable cutting heights and a forced air-cooling system for continuous power.

A wire-free bra from Hanes' Oh So Light Comfort Flex Fit line in black and nude, sized 2X. It has feather-light fabric for second-skin comfort, a comfort band for stay-in-place support, and flexible foam cups for shape. The listing describes its styling as nearly invisible under clothes.

A handmade waxed canvas insulated lunch bag from Hide & Drink in honey bourbon, with a grab handle and an easy-to-clean insulated interior. It is designed for office, school, picnic, travel, and commuting. The listing says the bag is handcrafted, lightweight, and durable, and it comes with a 101-year warranty.

A Misty unicorn stuffed animal from Melissa & Doug with a soft white body and bright purple mane and tail. It has shimmering patterned fabric on the hooves and horn and weighted hooves for steady standing. The plush is made with top-quality fill, and its surface can be washed.

A navy 500-thread-count twin sheet set from KRISTEX made of 100 percent long staple cotton in a sateen weave. It includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with deep pockets, and pillowcases with a hemmed finish. The listing says the sheets are breathable and machine washable, with color-fast dyes.

A cup holder phone mount with a 10-watt wireless car charger from NeotrixQI. Its base fits larger car cup holes, and an adjustable aluminum arm holds phones and tablets. The clamps close automatically when a phone is placed, and the listing says cases thicker than 5 millimeters may not charge.

A long-sleeve pleated dress for baby girls from The Children's Place in Simply White, sized 5T. It is made of 60 percent cotton and 40 percent polyester jersey with an all-over fair isle print. It has a crew neck, pullover style, and elasticized waist.

A 15-inch square side table from Zinus's Priyanka modern studio collection, with a rich brown wood-grain finish and a steel tubing frame. It measures 15 by 15 by 18 inches and has a lower shelf and a weight capacity of 100 pounds. It assembles easily and fits in small spaces.

A set of black universal cleaning plugs and caps from HEMPER Tech for cleaning, storage, and odor sealing of glass water pipes and rigs. The listing says they fit almost any glass joint and seal tightly. The set includes two medium plugs and one large plug.

A right-handed 38-inch red golf swing trainer from Matzie that the listing says improves grip, distance, release, and tempo. Its training grip places the thumb and index finger in set positions, and a heavier 3.7-ounce head supports a controlled release. The listing offers a 100 percent money-back guarantee.

A dual tray from SEA LIFE for mounting two lights or flashes on an underwater camera, which the listing says increases brightness, reduces shadowing, and adds stability. It attaches to cameras with a standard 1/4-20 tripod mount, and accessories snap on and off. It is made of fiber-reinforced polycarbonate with stainless steel hardware.

A single 12-millimeter clear acrylic ear gauge plug from Body Candy with a pink glitter heart pattern and a straight taper. It comes with two rubber O-rings and is sold individually, so buy two for a pair. The listing describes it as heart taper body jewelry.

A 63-inch white and black writing computer desk with a BIFMA certification, measuring about 63 by 23.7 by 29.5 inches. The E1-standard wood panel is waterproof with an anti-scratch surface, and a 1.2-millimeter metal frame supports it. It has four legs that install with a hex key.

A set of six clear display easel stands from Artliving that hold one teacup and one saucer each. The cup sits in front with the saucer standing behind, so both pieces are visible. The stands suit kitchens, dining rooms, and curio cabinets, and make a gift for dishware collectors.

An eight-pair pack of black compression socks from ACTINPUT in L/XL, rated 15 to 20 mmHg for women and men. They are made of 85 percent nylon, 10 percent polyester, and 5 percent elastane, with no stitches where they might rub. The listing suggests them for medical, nursing, travel, flight, running, and pregnancy use.

A vintage-style solid polished brass school bell with a wood handle from INsideOUT, measuring 12 inches high and 5.5 inches long. It is presented as both decorative and functional. The listing describes the design as vintage style.

A men's long-sleeve Terminal Tackle PFG shirt from Columbia in Key West and vivid blue logo colors, sized medium. It has Omni-Shade UV protection and built-in UPF 50 material, along with Omni-Wick technology that moves moisture to the surface to evaporate. It is described as breathable and quick-wicking for outdoor fishing.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens from Uni-ball Signo DX, model UM-151, with 0.38-millimeter tips. The pigment-based ink is described as smooth and waterproof, fade-resistant, and suited to writing notes, marking calendars, and everyday tasks. The listing calls them a favorite of artists and writers.

A set of 14 black cardboard bakery boxes from VGoodall, each 4 by 4 by 2.5 inches with an openable plastic window. The 300-GSM boxes are made for cupcakes and treats, and the set includes 18 meters of natural jute twine as a bonus. The listing describes them as handmade and food grade.

Women's blue ripped denim bib overall shorts from LookbookStore in size M, with a raw hem, distressed details, and adjustable straps with metal buckles. They have two side pockets and two back pockets and a light stretch. The listing suits them to casual, office, and party wear.

Rhodium-plated sterling silver stud earrings from LESA MICHELE with princess-cut cubic zirconia and a cushion-shaped halo, totaling 2 carats. They measure about .31 by .31 by .16 inches. The listing calls them a simple, sparkling gift for mothers, sisters, wives, and other women for any occasion.

A downloadable will and testament kit from Adams for use in the USA, covering all 50 states. It includes registration instructions to create a legally valid will, with forms to name beneficiaries and a guardian for minor children. The listing notes that the product must be registered to download state-specific forms.

A set of four wooden vehicle puzzles from SKYFIELD for toddlers aged 1 to 3, featuring a steamer, airplane, car, and police car in bright shapes. The smooth wooden pieces are designed to help children learn vehicles and build concentration, hand-eye coordination, and puzzle-solving skills.

A low-profile semi-flush ceiling fan with a dimmable 40-watt LED light from DLLT, offering three color temperatures from 3000K to 6500K. It has seven invisible blades, three fan speeds, a remote, and a sleep night-light mode. The listing describes it as suitable for indoor use.

A chrome flush-mount ceiling light from CO-Z with a crystal shade, measuring 12 by 12 by 6.1 inches. It holds two E26 bulbs up to 60 watts each and is dimmable. The shade is set with 143 crystal stones, and the anti-rust chrome dome is suited to entryways, hallways, and dining rooms.

A sterling silver engagement ring from LEMON GRASS in size 7, with a round halo of cubic zirconia and a micro-pave band. It is rhodium plated and listed as hypoallergenic and nickel free. The ring comes in a leather box and is backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee.

A One Piece Sabo themed leather flip case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max, made of shockproof TPU with a PU leather cover. It has three card slots and a cash slot, with cutouts for buttons and ports. The case can be converted into a stand for viewing at multiple angles.

A white 158-inch nylon window seal from Aozzy for portable air conditioners and tumble dryers. It wraps around an open casement or tilting window and zips around the air hose nozzle to stop warm air from flowing back in. The listing says it is not suited to sliding windows.

An XL surf green dish drying mat from Drymate measuring 19 by 24 inches, with a low-profile 0.13-inch design. It has absorbent polyester fabric with a waterproof, slip-resistant backing, and it is machine washable and made in the USA. The listing says it is suitable for air-drying dishes, glasses, silverware, and produce.

A 1500 mAh solar charger battery from Jiee Tec for hunting and game trail cameras. It has an internal safeguard circuit that cuts off power during overload and overdischarge, and it is weatherproof for indoor and outdoor use. It mounts to a tree, pole, or tripod and works with many Suntek trail camera models.

Men's black mesh shorts from Russell Athletic in X-large with a 9-inch inseam. The breathable mesh construction and Dri-Power moisture-wicking technology are designed to keep the wearer cool and dry. An elastic waistband with an internal draw cord provides an adjustable fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

A women's white long-sleeve ribbed knit tee from Romwe in large, with an asymmetrical cross-wrap neckline and a slim fit. It is made of 70 percent polyester, 25 percent cotton, and 5 percent spandex, and the listing says it runs small. It is machine washed with like colors.

Clip-on heel wheels from Neon Street Rollers that turn regular shoes into roller skates, in dark blue. The wheels have LEDs that light up as they turn, with no batteries required. They adjust to fit many shoes and suit ages 6 and up, with a 132-pound maximum user weight.

A roll of white matte graphic art tape from Chartpak, 1/8 inch wide and 324 inches long, for even, solid lines on charts and signage. It has a permanent adhesive that works on plastic, whiteboard, glass, paper, wood, metal, and ceramic surfaces. It is made in the USA and suited to clean, dry surfaces indoors or outdoors.

A wood toddler bed from Delta Children with a Nick Jr. PAW Patrol design, recommended for children 15 months and older. It has two high side rails for a transition to a big kid bed and measures 54.5 by 29.9 by 18.9 inches. The bed is JPMA certified.

A pair of ivory linen-textured sheer curtain panels from MIULEE, each 52 by 84 inches with eight silver grommets. The soft sheer fabric lets in light and air flow while offering a degree of privacy. The listing says the panels suit any room and are well made.

A small 11 by 14 inch magnetic dry erase whiteboard from Amazon Basics with a lightweight aluminum frame. It doubles as a bulletin board for photos and notes and includes two magnets and a black marker with a built-in eraser. Self-stick pads and mounting magnets are included, and it hangs horizontally or vertically.

A 12-pack of reusable PEVA storage bags from Comken, including five sandwich bags, five snack bags, and two large bags. The bags are described as BPA free, PVC free, and lead free, and are intended for snacks, fruit, and sandwiches. They are not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher use, and should not hold hot food.

A seven-pack of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls from Carter's in 18 months, in an assorted pack. The listing notes strong snaps that hold up to wear and washing. The listing offers few other details.

A vanilla, plant-based collagen builder powder from PlantFusion in an 11.43-ounce container. The formula is non-GMO, gluten-free, dairy-free, and vegan, and the listing says it contains amla fruit extract, amino acids, and plant proteins to support collagen. It can be mixed into a shake, smoothie, or coffee, and is marketed for skin, joints, and hair.

Six refill bulbs for Wallflowers plug-in fragrance from Bath & Body Works in Sweet Cinnamon Pumpkin, packaged as three twin-packs. The scent blends spicy pumpkin with sweet butter and vanilla cream. The listing notes the fragrance is discontinued and hard to find.

specs.types: candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels

record.description: A snack box from WorldWideTreats containing at least eight pre-packaged snacks made in Eastern European countries such as Russia, Romania, Latvia, and Croatia. Each box can include a combination of candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. The listing notes that the photos show example items and that contents vary.

A black resin skull-shaped gear shift knob from Lunsom with aluminum alloy attachment parts. It is designed to fit most automatic and manual vehicles, and several adapters are included. The listing describes its smooth feel and presents it as a novel accent for skull fans.

A set of 200 ivory plastic pearls from Z-synka with no holes, plus six packets of water gels for floating them. The pearls come in 20-millimeter, 14-millimeter, and 10-millimeter sizes and are intended for vase fillers, table scatter, weddings, and home decor. The listing says they can be reused an unlimited number of times.

A Graco Modes Bassinet travel system in the Wynton design, combining a bassinet stroller that converts to an infant car seat carrier and a toddler stroller. It includes a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat with a Click Connect base. The listing describes nine riding options and spot-cleaning for the seat pad.

A white 24-inch flower box tray from Novelty made of lightweight, fade-resistant plastic, measuring 22.25 by 6.5 by 1 inches. It fits 24-inch flower boxes and protects decks, patios, and indoor surfaces. The listing says the flower box is not included and that the tray is made in the USA.

A medium light blue undershelf storage basket from Smart Design with a steel flat-wire frame that is rust resistant. It measures 16 by 10.25 by 5.5 inches, with snug arms that attach under a standard cabinet shelf. The listing suggests it for spices, plates, and napkins.

specs.chain: with or without 18 in curb chain

record.description: A tiny 0.75 by 0.5 inch heart locket from Lifetime Jewelry that holds up to two photos, with 24-karat gold plating. It is available with or without an 18-inch curb link chain and comes in a black velvet pouch. The listing says it is made in the USA.

A brass Kaweco Sport fountain pen with a fine 23-karat gold-plated steel nib, made by hand in Nuremberg. It weighs 21 grams and measures about 13 centimeters with the cap posted and 10.5 centimeters closed, a pocket-friendly size. The listing describes it as offering a soft writing feel and first-class quality.

Self-fanning volume eyelash extensions in blue from a 0.07-millimeter thickness and 14 to 20 millimeter length range, with a D curl. The listing says the lashes are heat-set twice for a stable curl and treated roots that hold without residue. Lashes come in five colors and are sold as a box of easy-fan lashes.

A weathered white wall-mounted coat rack from Ilyapa in distressed wood with five metal hooks, measuring 24 by 4.5 inches. It holds up to 30 pounds and includes mounting hardware. The rack suits jackets, hats, bags, and umbrellas in kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms.

A stainless steel hanger for fishing and hunting waders and boots, made of 1/4-inch stainless steel and a chain design. The listing says it can hold 200 pounds or more when installed properly and helps waders keep their shape while drying. It hangs in closets or from tree branches, keeping boots off the ground.

A men's full-zip jacket from Spyder made of 100 percent polyester bonded grid-knit fleece with a sherpa lining. It has two side zipper pockets and an embroidered Spyder logo on the front. The listing describes it as an extra-cozy layer for cool months or for wearing under an insulated shell.

A chocolate Easy Step III pet stair from Pet Gear for small, medium, and large dogs. It helps pets reach couches and higher beds, and its slight incline reduces the number of steps needed. The removable carpet tread is easy to clean, and the stairs measure 23 by 16 by 25 inches.

specs.refills: black and red ballpoint, pencil, stylus

record.description: A satin black Cross Tech3+ multifunction pen with chrome trim, personalized with up to 25 characters of free engraving. It twists between a black and a red ballpoint, a 0.5-millimeter pencil, and a stylus on the cap, with a hidden eraser. The listing describes a lifetime mechanical guarantee and ships in one business day.

A black short-sleeve Raiders fan T-shirt from Smack Apparel in X-large, with the slogan 'True 'Til the Day I'm Through.' It is 100 percent cotton, pre-shrunk, and screen printed in the USA. The listing says it is machine washable and that the design is copyrighted by Smack Apparel.

A boys' sandal from Reef in aqua and green, sized 11/12 M US little kid. It has a soft EVA footbed with anatomical arch support, a vegan leather strap with a jersey lining, and a flexible triple-density EVA build. The molded outsole is designed to provide grip.

A white kids' Real Madrid home jersey from adidas in medium, made from 100 percent recycled polyester doubleknit. It has a regular, straight fit with short sleeves, a crewneck, and mesh inserts under the arms. The listing describes the sweat-wicking Climalite fabric and a woven Real Madrid crest.
A 7-foot HDTV cable from Hyperkin for connecting Saturn consoles to HDTVs. It supports 720p resolution and is described as providing clear picture and crisp audio. A 6-foot micro cable is included.

Silver mirror replacement lenses from LENS SWAP for Oakley Holbrook sunglasses with model numbers starting OO9102 in a 55-millimeter size. The polarized lenses are 1.4 millimeters thick and provide UV protection with a dark silver mirror coating and 6 percent light transmission. The listing says they do not fit XL frames.

A women's thong sandal from Bionica's Nimah line in poppy, sized 9 B(M) US. It has fabric straps, a soft nubuck toe post, and a quick-drying molded EVA footbed with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar. The shock-absorbing midsole and slip-resistant rubber outsole are designed for beach and water use.

A jumbo pet bowl from JW Pet Company with a rubber bottom that grips slippery surfaces and a heavyweight base to minimize movement on tile and linoleum. It is dishwasher safe and suited to extra-large breed dogs. Colors vary and are assorted.

An unframed officially licensed LEGO Batman grid wall poster from Trends International, measuring 22.375 by 34 inches. It is printed on gloss FSC-certified poster paper and can be framed or hung with clips, pins, or mounts. The listing suggests it for bedrooms, kids' rooms, offices, and other spaces.

A three-pack of sleeveless toddler boys' tank tops from Simply Joys by Carter's in size 3T, in blue stripe, orange gators, and gray stripe. They have a ribbed neckline and pocket detail, and the packaging is tag-free. The listing says the set is sold exclusively for Amazon members.

A double-wall kraft Gaylord bottom box from BOX USA, measuring 48 by 40 by 36 inches, made from 275-pound corrugated kraft board with ECT-48 rating. It is sold in packs of 75 and shipped flat in pallet quantities. The listing says it is used to consolidate multiple-piece shipments and protect bulky, irregularly shaped items.

A black men's anti-theft sling bag from Seoky Rop made of water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It measures 13.8 by 6.7 by 3.2 inches and has two main pockets, a front zippered pocket, and an anti-theft interlayer. It has an external USB charging port and headphone hole, and the power bank is not included.

A 5.5-inch hand-painted resin Willow Tree figure, With My Grandmother, showing an older woman in a cream dress seated on a gray bench beside a young girl holding hands. It comes with a sentiment card in a fitted box. The figure can be displayed on a shelf, table, or mantel.

A stainless steel Leatherman Surge heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools, replaceable premium wire cutters, and spring-action scissors. It includes four outside-opening blades and a blade exchanger, and it ships with a premium nylon sheath. The listing describes one-hand opening and a 25-year warranty for the product made in Portland, Oregon.

A women's short-sleeve double-breasted chef's coat from Chef's Apparel in white, size small, with ten buttons and a matching chef hat made of the same cloth. The hat has Velcro fastening to fit a range of head sizes. It can be worn both ways, and sizing is by bust measurement.

Black 3-millimeter neoprene gloves from DiNeop in medium, for diving, kayaking, snorkeling, and surfing. They have a form-fitting design with flexible neoprene, anti-slip grip, and an adjustable Velcro wrist strap. The listing says they help protect hands from rocks, sea lice, jellyfish, and coral while keeping them warm underwater.

Juniors' Belle-wash denim shortalls from WallFlower in small, with adjustable straps, a 3-inch cuffed inseam, and a zipper closure at the center front. They have multiple pockets and are made with Lycra for a soft feel. They are machine washable in cold water and can be tumble dried on low.

A space gray USB-C hub from LENTION, model CB-C31, with four USB 3.0 ports at up to 5 Gbps and a USB-C charging port that passes through up to 60 watts of power delivery. It is plug and play with no drivers needed. It works with several laptops, including MacBook, Surface, and Chromebook.

An 18 by 24 inch museum quality poster of Alex Grey's Oversoul artwork, sold as an official item. The listing includes the artist's note that human consciousness is a bridge between planetary and cosmic consciousness. The listing gives few other details.

A deep sea and charcoal low rocker camp chair from ALPS Mountaineering with a powder-coated steel frame and TechMesh fabric. It folds compactly with a shoulder bag, and its low-profile rocker locks into place. It measures 22 by 17 by 31 inches, weighs 11 pounds, and supports up to 300 pounds.

A two-pack of Child's Play 2 Good Guys batteries from Trick or Treat Studios, sized D and officially licensed through Universal Studios. The listing says they are based on onscreen and behind-the-scenes shots and are accessories for the Good Guy doll. They are sold as a collectible accessory.
